While Jones leaves the door open for a potential return in the future, he is currently prioritizing his role as a father.

stories.title: STARDOM Fukuyama Results: Konami Wins, Hina Defeats Miyu Amasaki
stories.tldr: STARDOM continued its Silver Week Tour with an event in Fukuyama at Big Rose, highlighted by key victories for the H.A.T.E. stable. Hometown fighter Konami led her team to a main event win by pinning Saya Iida after using black spray and a punt kick. Earlier on the card, Hina scored a major non-title upset by pinning Goddess of Stardom Champion Miyu Amasaki with the Mad Splash. The show also featured ongoing championship previews, including another look at the upcoming Wonder of Stardom title match between Hanan and Ruaka.

stories.title: Danshoku Dieno Captures DDT Ironman Title in Niigata
stories.tldr: Danshoku Dieno surprised Ilusion with a Lip Lock and pinfall to capture the Ironman Heavymetalweight Championship following DDT Pro-Wrestling's September 19 show in Niigata. The opportunistic ambush occurred after Ilusion interrupted a closing announcement to boast about his championship status, which came on the heels of an earlier tag team victory on the card. Meanwhile, the main event featured HARASHIMA defeating Super Sasadango Machine in a bout celebrating Sasadango's 24th anniversary in the industry before Dieno provided the event's final twist.

stories.title: Shota Umino Comments on Ryohei Oiwa and Callum Newman
stories.tldr: Shota Umino recently addressed the rapid rise of peers like Ryohei Oiwa and Callum Newman in New Japan Pro-Wrestling, making it clear that their swift success does not shake his confidence. Despite missing most of the G1 Climax due to a concussion and amnesia, Umino remains focused on his own developmental pace rather than rushing to copy others. He believes that his unique background and contrasting approach will ultimately help strengthen the promotion when he reaches the top to stay.

stories.title: AEW's Rush Denies 'Injury Prone' Claims and Confirms He is Healthy
stories.tldr: AEW star Rush has taken to social media to push back against online speculation and fan claims that he is injury prone following his prolonged absence from television. The former ROH World Champion clarified that he has only suffered one actual injury during his AEW tenure, alongside a minor knee tweak during the Continental Classic. Rush emphasized that he remains fully healthy, dedicated to his craft by training and studying in Mexico, and ready to return to action at any time.

stories.title: AEW Star John Silver Marries Partner Denise Liguori
stories.tldr: AEW star John Silver and his longtime partner, Denise Liguori, have officially tied the knot after getting engaged in June 2025. The couple celebrated their wedding on September 19, surrounded by family, friends, and familiar faces from the wrestling world, including fellow AEW star Chuck Taylor. Silver shared photos and videos from the ceremony on social media to announce the happy news to his fans.

stories.title: Sting's Son Garrett Borden Makes AEW In-Ring Debut
stories.tldr: Garrett Borden, the son of wrestling legend Sting and older brother of Steven Borden Jr., made his All Elite Wrestling in-ring debut in a dark match prior to the September 19 episode of Collision in Charleston, West Virginia. Training under Dustin Rhodes at the Rhodes Wrestling Association, Borden secured a victory over Kiran Grey. This milestone follows his professional debut earlier in May and his previous appearance portraying the Surfer Sting persona during his father's retirement match at Revolution 2024.

stories.title: Backstage Status Update on Britt Baker Following AEW Return
stories.tldr: Britt Baker recently made her long-awaited AEW return on the September 9 Rebel Heart edition of Dynamite after nearly two years away from the ring. Following her comeback match, where she teamed up with Hikaru Shida and Persephone to defeat Hyan, Maya World, and Thunder Rosa, reports indicate she is officially back on the road with the company. She is expected to make several upcoming television appearances as part of her return. Fans are especially anticipating her potential involvement in the September 30 episode of Dynamite, which takes place in her hometown of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, though an appearance for that specific date is not yet confirmed.

stories.title: Mercedes Moné's Ex-Husband Sarath Ton Expecting Baby Girl with New Wife
stories.tldr: Sarath Ton, known to wrestling fans as former WWE star and costume designer Mikaze, announced that he and his new wife Miranda are expecting a baby girl. Ton was previously married to wrestling star Mercedes Mone, though the couple actually separated quietly in December 2020 before their divorce became public in July 2024. Both have since moved on, with Ton marrying Miranda in late 2025 and Mone entering a relationship with AEW star The Beast Mortos.

stories.title: Tony Khan Thought The Outrunners Were Already Under AEW Contract
stories.tldr: The Outrunners recently shared the wild and persistent way they eventually secured their AEW contracts through relentless extra work and massive road trips. Truth Magnum and Turbo Floyd frequently lied about their locations to land bookings, tricking Tony Khan into assuming they were already officially signed to the roster. After ignoring a surreal Twitter direct message from Khan offering them a match against Sting, the duo officially cemented their unforgettable path into the company.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live Discusses Myron Reed's Potential in AEW
stories.tldr: A recent episode of Wrestling Observer Live hosted by Josh Nason explores Myron Reed's potential as a singles star in AEW following his standout match against Darby Allin on Collision. The discussion raises questions about whether Tony Khan will provide Reed with the necessary runway, while also contrasting his situation with the stalled momentum of Hook and Konosuke Takeshita. Additionally, the show touches upon the potential launch of Club WWE for the upcoming Worlds Collide event and fan reactions to paying for expanding content, alongside various notes on wrestling and the UFC.

stories.title: Malakai Black Pays Emotional Tribute to Late Musician Andy Williams
stories.tldr: Former WWE and AEW star Malakai Black recently paid an emotional tribute to his close friend and fellow wrestler Andy The Butcher Williams, who unexpectedly passed away on September 5 following a medical emergency during a tag team match. During an appearance on Zelvx and Charlie Girl, a visibly emotional Black recalled Williams as a genuinely wonderful human being and a loyal best friend who constantly shared his music and supported those around him. Black also shared the heartbreaking story of how he learned about the tragedy from Donovan Dijak backstage at a PROGRESS Wrestling event in England just hours before his own title match.

stories.title: Maria Kanellis Reveals AEW Extended Contract During Tumor Recovery
stories.tldr: Former wrestling star Maria Kanellis recently opened up about her harrowing health battle with a rare one-in-a-million tumor known as a pheochromocytoma. She revealed that AEW graciously extended her contract by three months while she was still recovering in the hospital following her surgery in October. The tumor severely impacted her physical and mental well-being by altering her hormones, affecting her heart, causing erratic blood pressure, and changing her personality. Despite the dark period and the difficult end to her active career, Kanellis remains deeply grateful for the support she received and the many blessings wrestling brought into her life.

stories.title: Rumors on AEW 2K Console Video Game Partnership Unlikely
stories.tldr: Industry reports indicate that a future partnership between video game publisher 2K and All Elite Wrestling is highly unlikely if the publisher's current deal with WWE eventually expires. Wrestling journalist Sean Ross Sapp addressed the rumor during a recent question and answer session, explaining that the two companies have fundamentally different philosophies regarding game development. While AEW prefers to support a single long-term title, 2K relies on an annual release model that would require substantial ongoing investment.

stories.title: AEW All Out 2026 Match Card Updates and Andrade Title Defense
stories.tldr: Following recent events on Collision, several major matches have been officially added to the upcoming All Out pay-per-view and its pre-show. Andrade El Idolo will officially defend his AEW National Championship against PAC after a post-match angle on Saturday night. Additionally, the Tailgate Brawl pre-show lineup has been fully fleshed out with new multi-man tag team action and a singles clash.

stories.title: Logan Paul and Jake Paul Tour Pentagon and Address Military Members
stories.tldr: WWE star Logan Paul and his brother Jake Paul recently toured the Pentagon and addressed U.S. military members, meeting with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. During the visit, both brothers delivered speeches expressing gratitude for the armed forces and the United States. This high-profile appearance aligns with a broader pattern of growing connections between prominent WWE figures and the current administration. Meanwhile, Logan Paul remains sidelined from in-ring action due to a triceps injury and is not expected to be cleared until at least November.

stories.title: Dustin Rhodes Reveals Details Behind Goldust vs Roddy Piper Backlot Brawl
stories.tldr: Dustin Rhodes recently shared fascinating behind-the-scenes details about the infamous Goldust versus Roddy Piper Backlot Brawl at WrestleMania XII. He revealed that the chaotic match only happened because original plans for a street fight against Razor Ramon fell apart just two weeks prior. Rhodes also discussed Vince McMahon's obsession with O.J. Simpson imagery for the segment and his own initial hesitation to fully embrace the androgynous nature of the Goldust character.

stories.title: WWE Lineup and Match Additions for September 21 Monday Night RAW
stories.tldr: WWE Raw General Manager Adam Pearce has announced a stacked lineup for the September 21, 2026 episode from the Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, Texas. The show features high stakes with men and women Money in the Bank qualifying matches, alongside intense personal rivalries like Bayley versus Lyra Valkyria. Additionally, both Penta and LA Knight are scheduled to address the WWE Universe following major developments surrounding World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns.

stories.title: Raquel Rodriguez Calls Judgment Day the Strongest Faction in WWE History
stories.tldr: Raquel Rodriguez recently spoke with the San Antonio Express-News about her time in The Judgment Day and the deep impact the faction has had on her career. She highlighted the stable's unbreakable family bond, noting that regardless of which members are traveling or appearing on television, the group always delivers full energy. Rodriguez even joked that kicking Finn Balor out of the group created a special trauma bonding experience for the remaining members. Ultimately, she boldly claimed that this loyalty and mindset make The Judgment Day the longest reigning and strongest faction in WWE history.

stories.title: Danhausen Reflects on WrestleMania Segment with John Cena and TV Cameo Hopes
stories.tldr: WWE star Danhausen recently reflected on sharing the ring with John Cena during a memorable segment at WrestleMania in Las Vegas, where he hit a Five-Knuckle Shuffle on The Miz before disappearing in a smoke bomb. Beyond the squared circle, Danhausen has been enjoying mainstream pop culture success following his viral involvement with the New York Knicks and ESPN appearances. Looking ahead, the very nice, very evil star has expressed ambitious career goals outside of wrestling, including a dream cameo on The Simpsons and pitching his own sitcom concept.

stories.title: John Cena WrestleMania 41 Trading Card Sells for Record $329,400
stories.tldr: A one-of-one John Cena trading card featuring his autograph and an event-used patch from WrestleMania 41 has sold at Goldin for a record-breaking $329,400. Bidding for the 2025 Topps Royalty card originally opened at $15,000 before escalating dramatically through fierce competition. The historic sale commemorates Cena defeating Cody Rhodes at the event to capture a record 17th WWE World Championship.

stories.title: Liv Morgan Names Favorite Crowd Reaction Involving Dominik Mysterio
stories.tldr: In a recent interview, Liv Morgan revealed that her all-time favorite WWE crowd reaction occurred at SummerSlam 2024 when Dominik Mysterio betrayed Rhea Ripley to help her retain the Women's World Championship. She highlighted the polarized crowd response to Mysterio's post-match kiss, noting that even Stephanie McMahon loved the iconic drama. Additionally, Morgan shared a surprising personal detail, disclosing that she is a legally ordained minister who can officiate weddings. This interview follows recent shifts in her career, including dropping her championship to Stephanie Vaquer.

stories.title: The Bryan & Vinny Show Podcast Episode Recap
stories.tldr: The latest episode of the podcast covers a busy week in professional wrestling, highlighted by the SmackDown recap featuring Sami Zayn versus Kevin Owens in a World Title match and ongoing build toward Money in the Bank. Hosts also review the AEW Collision card as the promotion builds momentum for the upcoming All Out pay-per-view event. Additionally, fans in the Philadelphia area are given details on where they can catch Bryan wrestling live and attending a book signing on Sunday.

stories.title: The Full Story and Legal Fallout of Janel Grant and Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: Former WWE employee Janel Grant filed a devastating federal lawsuit against Vince McMahon in 2024, accusing him of severe sexual abuse, trafficking, and coercion that began after they met in 2019. The explosive case quickly dragged other figures into the controversy while raising serious questions about corporate accountability within WWE. Although multiple legal battles, settlements, and a 2026 arbitration agreement ultimately pushed the public lawsuit out of the courts, Grant has continued to speak out about her experiences and the initial confidentiality agreements.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Digital Exclusives and Match Notes
stories.tldr: Following Friday's episode of SmackDown, WWE released several digital exclusives highlighting new backstage feuds and challenges. Ricky Saints confronted AAA Cruiserweight Champion Rey Fenix, leading to a physical altercation after Saints demanded a title shot. Meanwhile, Blake Monroe demanded attention and vowed revenge against Giulia, while Baron Corbin sent a fierce warning to Trick Williams.

stories.title: Perry Saturn Reflects on Moppy Storyline as Vince McMahon Punishment
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Perry Saturn recently revealed that his infamous Moppy storyline was actually a punishment orchestrated by Vince McMahon. The creative direction stemmed from an incident during a match against Mike Bell where Saturn went off-script after being dropped on his head. Despite Saturn refusing to falsely promise Vince that he would never react defensively again, management assigned him the inanimate cleaning tool. Even though Saturn tried to prevent it from succeeding, the absurd gimmick surprisingly began to get over with fans before being abruptly ended.

stories.title: Speculation on Future Second and Third-Generation Factions in WWE
stories.tldr: The NXT faction BirthRight features strict guidelines requiring members to come from professional wrestling families. As the group prepares for a potential main roster transition, analysts are speculating on which second and third-generation stars could join. Names such as Dominik Mysterio, Bron Breakker, and Cody Rhodes offer intriguing possibilities ranging from new recruits to potential faction leaders. Each wrestler would bring unique family legacies and dynamic character storylines to the stable.

stories.title: Analyzing WWE Stars Who Could Benefit From a Brand Switch
stories.tldr: With the absence of a traditional WWE Draft, wrestlers who have hit creative walls on Monday Night Raw should consider a brand switch to revitalize their careers. Seth Rollins needs a move to SmackDown to escape stale storylines on Raw and pursue fresh feuds, including a potential program with Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn. Similarly, IYO SKY has faded into the background on Raw following the returns of Stephanie Vaquer and Becky Lynch and would benefit from heading to SmackDown to chase the Interim WWE Women's Title while awaiting Rhea Ripley's return.

stories.title: Looking Ahead to Potential WWE Veteran Retirements in 2027
stories.tldr: Following a wave of high profile retirements over a recent thirteen month span, attention is turning toward which wrestling veterans might hang up their boots in 2027. The Bella Twins are among those projected to finish up, with Nikki Bella having previously revealed plans to retire from in-ring competition by the end of 2027 following their recent return. Hall of Famer Rey Mysterio continues to take brutal punishments and put on classic matches at age 51, leading to speculation about a potential final match against his son Dominik. Meanwhile, Asuka has stepped away temporarily due to a personal matter but could potentially return in 2027 for a final run and a proper sendoff.

stories.title: Jim Cornette Discusses Origin of Tennis Racket and Early John Cena
stories.tldr: Wrestling legend Jim Cornette recently sat down for a WWE Photo Shoot segment to look back at his storied career through a collection of archival pictures. During the interview, he shared the fascinating backstory behind his iconic tennis racket and offered rare insights into the very early days of John Cena's wrestling journey. The discussion provided fans with a nostalgic and informative look at different eras of professional wrestling through the eyes of one of its most outspoken managers.

stories.title: WWE Vault Releases Full Episode of Legends with JBL Featuring Hall & Nash
stories.tldr: The WWE Vault YouTube channel has released a full episode of Legends with JBL featuring professional wrestling icons Scott Hall and Kevin Nash. The in-depth conversation covers major historical topics in the industry, including the formation and impact of the nWo and the controversial influence of The Kliq. Fans can now stream the complete interview to hear firsthand stories from two of the most influential figures in Monday Night War history.

stories.title: Original Creative Plans Behind JBL's Unexpected Clothesline Spree Revealed
stories.tldr: For months, former WWE Champion JBL surprised fans across various independent promotions by randomly appearing to deliver his signature Clothesline From Hell without any immediate explanation. Recent reports have revealed that Major League Wrestling and other independent promoters tried to build long-term storylines around these attacks, including a potential Battle of the Lariats against Satoshi Kojima or a Yellowstone-inspired bitter cowboy invasion angle. However, these creative plans ultimately fell through because JBL only wanted to hit his signature move and create a buzz without committing to a full program or taking a loss. Ultimately, the viral spree was simply a fun way for JBL to help smaller promotions gain attention and scratch his own wrestling itch on his own terms.

stories.title: WWE Vault Highlights Top Matches from 2001 WCW/ECW Invasion
stories.tldr: The WWE Vault is revisiting one of the most chaotic and memorable eras in professional wrestling history by highlighting top matches from the 2001 Invasion storyline. During this period, the combined forces of World Championship Wrestling and Extreme Championship Wrestling attempted a hostile takeover of the World Wrestling Federation. Fans can now relive these classic televised bouts that defined a major cross-promotional war.

stories.title: Mick Foley Calls Out Donald Trump Over White House Media Ban
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley recently used his Instagram Story to criticize President Donald Trump after reporters from CNN, MSNBC and Politico had their White House credentials confiscated and were denied entry. Foley condemned the action as a terrifying blow to democracy, continuing his months-long trend of openly questioning Trump's leadership and political empathy. While Trump defended the ban by citing years of what he calls fake news, critics argue the decision severely threatens press freedom.

stories.title: Prospective WWE Talent Recalls Security Escort After Triple H Encounter
stories.tldr: Former OVW Heavyweight Champion Jamin Olivencia recently recalled how a series of backstage missteps in 2014 and 2015 ruined his chances of signing with WWE. After being encouraged by Stephanie McMahon to speak with Triple H about securing a meeting, Olivencia repeatedly approached Triple H at inopportune times to pitch himself. This persistence ultimately led to him being escorted out of the building by security and fueled a bizarre backstage rumor that he had followed Triple H into a bathroom.

stories.title: Potential Seth Rollins Rivalries Upon His Return to WWE Television
stories.tldr: Seth Rollins has been absent from WWE television since SummerSlam 2026 but recently made his in-ring return during a South American live tour, signaling an imminent return to weekly programming. As he prepares to come back, there are three major stars he could reignite past rivalries with, including LA Knight, Bron Breakker, and Drew McIntyre. These potential feuds offer fresh dynamic shifts and high-stakes rematches for the former World Heavyweight Champion upon his comeback.

stories.title: Rob Conway Recalls Receiving High Praise From Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Rob Conway recently reflected on his time with the company and shared a memorable piece of high praise he received from Vince McMahon during his run as part of La Résistance. According to Conway, McMahon compared his in-ring work favorably to WWE legend Bret Hart while encouraging him to focus more on his character and gimmick. Conway explained how this feedback shaped his approach to wrestling, leading to a greater emphasis on generating heat rather than purely focusing on five-star matches.

stories.title: Predicting Roman Reigns' Next WWE Title Opponents and Rematches
stories.tldr: With Roman Reigns holding the WWE World Heavyweight Championship, the Original Tribal Chief faces a massive target on his back and is lined up for several high profile rematches. Confirmed and rumored contenders include LA Knight, his former family member Solo Sikoa, WrestleMania opponent CM Punk, and his ultimate rival Cody Rhodes. These potential bouts build on deep storytelling, past title encounters, and historic matches that continue to shape the current landscape of WWE.

stories.title: NXT Call-Ups Aligning with Main Roster WWE Factions
stories.tldr: Recent WWE main roster call-ups have increasingly seen former NXT talent align with established stars on Raw and SmackDown, creating fresh faction dynamics. Rumors suggest even more crossovers are on the horizon as NXT prospects are positioned to join forces with main roster veterans. Potential future alliances range from returning international connections and independent wrestling tag-team reunions to dominant family bloodline stables. These strategic pairings aim to shake up the brand landscapes and provide compelling new storylines for fans.

stories.title: Seth Rollins Reacts to Chicago Bears Loss and Caleb Williams Injury
stories.tldr: WWE star and avid Chicago Bears fan Seth Rollins experienced a massive swing in emotions during the opening weeks of the NFL season. After celebrating a dominant week one performance, his mood soured entirely when the Bears managed only three points in a brutal week two loss to the Minnesota Vikings. To make matters worse, rookie quarterback Caleb Williams suffered a fourth-quarter leg injury and had to be carted off the field, prompting Rollins to angrily declare on social media that he hates football for life.

stories.title: Speculation and Creative Plans for Trish Stratus' Return to WWE
stories.tldr: Following recent comments from WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus about the right conditions for an in-ring comeback, speculation has grown regarding her potential return to the company. Stratus last wrestled in July 2025, and her future appearances depend on checking specific boxes to pay the business forward. Industry discussions have now highlighted three potential creative directions for her next steps, including teaming up with rising talent Sol Ruca or facing stars like Rhea Ripley and Blake Monroe.

stories.title: Status and Return Timelines for Injured WWE Stars
stories.tldr: Following recent high-profile returns on WWE programming, attention has turned to other talent currently sidelined with various injuries. This report breaks down the current status and expected recovery timelines for Logan Paul, Elio LeFleur, Brie Bella, and Rhea Ripley. While Paul and LeFleur are nearing the final stages of their respective rehabilitations from arm and shoulder surgeries, Brie Bella and Rhea Ripley face more fluid timelines regarding their eventual in-ring comebacks.

stories.title: Jim Ross Admits He Was Embarrassed to Be Booked in WWE TV Angles
stories.tldr: Legendary wrestling commentator Jim Ross recently admitted that he felt embarrassed being booked into physical storylines and matches during his tenure with WWE. Despite participating in notable bouts like a main event at Madison Square Garden against Triple H, Ross felt ill-equipped and untrained for these physical roles. He ultimately left WWE in 2019 and transitioned to AEW, where he signed a massive commentary contract.

stories.title: Highlighting Stephanie Vaquer's Women's World Championship Run in WWE
stories.tldr: Stephanie Vaquer has enjoyed an explosive start to her WWE career, transitioning from a surprise signing after appearances in CMLL, NJPW, and AEW to capturing multiple championships. After dominant runs in NXT that included holding gold as a double champion, she recently defeated Liv Morgan in Santiago, Chile, to capture the WWE Women's World Championship with help from Becky Lynch. Now leading the Raw women's division, Vaquer has returned triumphantly to Mexico City and is already embroiled in high-stakes feuds involving The Judgment Day and Rey Mysterio.

stories.title: Bronson Reed Reflects on Turning on Seth Rollins as Career Highlight
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed recently reflected on his shocking betrayal of Seth Rollins in Australia as a major highlight of his WWE career. Alongside Bron Breakker and Paul Heyman, Reed attacked Rollins last October following Crown Jewel, effectively ending their alliance in The Vision. Reed noted that the surprise attack in front of his home country crowd made the moment unforgettable. Because both men subsequently suffered injuries, they never got to square off in the ring, leaving Reed eager for a future clash.

stories.title: Blake Monroe Pitches 'Legend Killer' Gimmick in WWE
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe recently revealed in an interview that she wants to introduce a female version of Randy Orton's iconic Legend Killer gimmick on the WWE main roster. During the discussion with Emily Mae, Monroe named four specific legendary stars she would target for retirement to help propel her to superstardom on SmackDown. Her pitch includes retiring Hall of Famer Trish Stratus, the Bella Twins as Nikki plans her exit by the end of 2027 and Brie deals with injuries, and Paige, who has hinted that her current WWE run might be her last.

stories.title: Predicting Potential Heel Turns at WWE Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: The 2026 WWE Money in the Bank premium live event in New Orleans features a high-profile card including a main event between Roman Reigns and LA Knight, alongside the ladder matches. Analysts are predicting potential surprise heel turns that could shock the audience after the matches conclude. Specifically, Tiffany Stratton could betray her friend and tag team partner Chelsea Green by cashing in her contract, while Solo Sikoa might interfere in the main event to cost LA Knight the championship.

stories.title: Omos Expresses Interest in Joining The Judgment Day
stories.tldr: WWE giant Omos recently expressed interest in joining The Judgment Day faction, stating that his services are available for the right price. During a recent radio appearance, Omos noted that while Dominik Mysterio has not officially approached him yet, he is ready to help Mysterio conquer the world. The two already share ties through the AAA promotion where they are part of the El Ojo faction. Omos also high-praised Mysterio as one of the hottest heels in the professional wrestling business today.

stories.title: AJ Lee Recalls Winning Over WWE Officials During Paid Tryout Promo
stories.tldr: AJ Lee recently reflected on her journey to WWE, specifically recalling how she impressed company officials during a paid tryout years before her famous career. Despite having no preparation, she was pulled aside on her very first day to cut a promo, channeling an early persona that immediately caught the attention of decision-makers. This spontaneous audition ultimately earned her the chance that kickstarted her path to becoming a trailblazing star in women's wrestling.

stories.title: Mr. T Reflects on Friendship and Wrestling Work with Hulk Hogan
stories.tldr: Mr. T recently reflected on his decades-long friendship and professional history with Hulk Hogan during a podcast appearance. The two icons first met on the set of Rocky III in 1982 and later headlined the main event of the very first WrestleMania together. Decades later, Mr. T still names Hogan as his favorite wrestler to watch due to their shared history and the bond they built in Hollywood and the ring.

stories.title: Jade Cargill Shares Inspiration Behind Her 'Jaded' Finisher
stories.tldr: WWE star Jade Cargill recently revealed the origins of her signature finisher, the Jaded, tracing it back to her early days in AEW with the help of former wrestler Ivelisse. Cargill drew major inspiration from WWE Hall of Famer Beth Phoenix and her devastating Glam Slam finisher, wanting a powerhouse move that showcased her opponents' fear. She specifically designed the maneuver to plaster her opponent's face on the camera so fans could clearly see their reaction before securing the victory. Today, Cargill continues to use the impactful finisher in WWE, where she has achieved massive success as a multi-time champion alongside tag team partner Bianca Belair.

stories.title: Trick Williams Compares Athletic Skillsets of Football and Pro Wrestling
stories.tldr: Before joining WWE, Trick Williams played football through college and beyond, experiencing a major athletic transition into professional wrestling. Speaking in an interview, he explained that football rewards players for staying on their feet, whereas wrestling requires learning how to fall and hit the ground. This fundamental difference made his initial WWE training particularly challenging as he had to unlearn his previous athletic instincts.

stories.title: Paige Assigned to WWE SmackDown Roster as Active Member
stories.tldr: Paige has officially been added to the WWE SmackDown roster after previously being listed as a free agent since her return at WrestleMania 42. Her appearances and matches have exclusively taken place on the blue brand in recent months, leading to the official roster update by the company. The former Divas Champion has not appeared or competed on Monday Night Raw since June.

stories.title: Bully Ray Discusses Whether LA Knight Should Win World Title at MITB
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Bully Ray recently evaluated whether LA Knight should defeat Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship at Money in the Bank. While an immediate title change would satisfy Knight's passionate fanbase, Ray worries it would lack long-term creative follow-up. Instead, Ray argues that Reigns should retain the title until WrestleMania to eventually face Oba Femi. Ultimately, Ray believes booking a hasty title change now would devalue the future magnitude of a major WrestleMania moment.

stories.title: AJ Styles Reflects on Earning Respect from Roman Reigns
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently reflected on his 2016 WWE debut and suspects that Roman Reigns initially did not like him. As the company's top star and locker room leader at the time, Reigns was initially wary of an outsider entering his territory. However, after sharing the ring and delivering an incredible storyline together, Styles believes he ultimately earned Reigns' trust and respect.

stories.title: Bronson Reed Explains Physique Transformation and Impact on Finisher
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed made a surprising return at Sunday Night's Main Event to assist Bron Breakker by delivering four Tsunami finishers to Oba Femi. Fans were shocked to see the star return 45 pounds lighter after undergoing a major physical transformation. Reed recently addressed concerns regarding his weight loss, assuring fans that his signature move will actually be more devastating than ever. He explained that his lighter frame allows him to jump higher, accelerate faster, and impact opponents with even greater force.

stories.title: Natalya Describes Pitching Character Ideas to Vince McMahon and Triple H
stories.tldr: WWE veteran Natalya recently discussed her experiences pitching character ideas to both Vince McMahon and Paul Triple H Levesque during an appearance on Busted Open Radio. She credited McMahon for being open to her ideas, even though it sometimes required her to first commit to less desirable creative directions like her infamous flatulence gimmick. Under Triple H, Natalya has successfully transitioned into a grittier, hardened veteran persona originating from her work at AAA and Bloodsport. She praised Triple H for his collaborative approach, which included reviewing her outside performances and helping build custom vignettes for her return to the main roster.

stories.title: Update on Ticket Sales for Upcoming WWE, AEW, and TNA Events
stories.tldr: Recent ticket sales data highlights a strong market for upcoming WWE premium live events while painting a more challenging picture for AEW and TNA pay-per-view offerings. Major WWE shows like Survivor Series and Money in the Bank are drawing thousands of fans, whereas AEW and TNA are experiencing softer numbers for their upcoming cards. Notably, a congested Chicago market will feature a head-to-head scheduling clash between a collaborative WWE, AAA, and NXT event and AEW All Out.

stories.title: Dakota Kai Indie Return and Career Status Update Following WWE Exit
stories.tldr: Following her WWE release in May 2025 and her indie return as Charlie in March 2026, Dakota Kai has wrestled only twice and remained largely inactive. Reports indicate her initial plan was to re-establish herself in New Japan Pro Wrestling before considering major promotions like TNA or AEW, though that move has faced unexplained delays. Despite her current inactivity, she remains well-liked in the industry and still holds potential for future opportunities with major wrestling companies.

stories.title: Mason Rook Addresses Online Criticism Over His Size and Look in NXT
stories.tldr: Mason Rook has responded to online criticism regarding his physical appearance in WWE NXT while continuing his rapid ascent in the company. Expanding on his recent media appearances, the British star named Gunther as his dream WrestleMania opponent and discussed a potential physical transition in the future. Furthermore, Rook has solidified his status by winning a triple threat match to become the new number one contender for the NXT Championship.

stories.title: WWE Confirms Full 14-Team Field for NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: WWE has finalized the complete 14-team field for the upcoming 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic starting this Tuesday on NXT. The newly added participants include The Tokyo Bad Boys, Sean Legacy and Dorian Van Dux, Harley Riggins and Jax Presley, Shido Ash and Viktor Zanov, Hank and Tank, The Creed Brothers, The Wagner Brothers, and The Vanity Project. Notably, NXT Tag Team Champions The Vanity Project and AAA Tag Team Champions The Wagner Brothers have secured first-round byes in the tournament.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff Compares WWE Netflix Edits to WCW Turner Regulations
stories.tldr: Following recent criticism over altered crowd audio on Netflix, WWE is now facing scrutiny for post-production edits that remove blood and censor fan reactions on replays. Former WCW boss Eric Bischoff weighed in on the situation, comparing these changes to the rigid corporate sanitization he dealt with under Turner Broadcasting. Bischoff recalled being forced to digitally clean up bloody footage after live broadcasts to satisfy network executives. These ongoing alterations suggest that modern wrestling replays are increasingly subject to strict corporate oversight long after the cameras stop rolling.

stories.title: Kaito Kiyomiya, Yoshiki Inamura, and NOAH N-1 Victory Updates
stories.tldr: Kaito Kiyomiya maintained his unbeaten streak in the N-1 Victory tournament with a victory over Takashi Sugiura in Osaka, while Yoshiki Inamura secured a major win against Shane Haste. The tournament now shifts to Tokushima for crucial B Block action featuring a marquee match between Kenoh and KENTA. Kitamiya enters the next round holding the sole lead in the B Block.

stories.title: STARDOM Upcoming Events and Fan Signings
stories.tldr: STARDOM has announced upcoming fan interaction events as part of its Silver Week schedule, including a special portrait handover session featuring Rian on September 23 in Shimonoseki. Additionally, Utami Hayashishita's autograph session on September 25 in Osaka will feature an adjusted schedule due to her commitments with another promotion. Both events carry specific guidelines regarding purchases, strict cutoffs, and operational rules for attendees.

stories.title: GLEAT Books Title Challenges for October 9 Korakuen Hall Event
stories.tldr: GLEAT has announced two major championship matches for their upcoming October 9 event at Tokyo Korakuen Hall, titled GLEAT Ver.EX. TEAM NOAH veteran Atsushi Kotoge will challenge El Lindaman for the G-REX Championship, while Simon Gotch will face Takanori Ito for the LIDET UWF World Championship under the promotion's specialized UWF rules. The stacked card also features high-profile tag team action, including a cross-promotional six-woman match involving talent from Marigold. Additional matches, ticket details, and the final running order have been fully outlined by the promotion ahead of the evening show.

stories.title: Velvet Sky Set to Appear at WrestleCade After Years of Refusing
stories.tldr: Former TNA star Velvet Sky has announced she is finally open to making her first-ever appearance at the WrestleCade convention. For years, Sky consistently turned down the event because it falls on Thanksgiving weekend, prioritizing holiday family time above all else. However, she has now proposed a compromise to appear on Saturday, with a potential extension to Sunday as well. While nothing is officially booked yet, she has invited interested promoters to reach out via email to discuss potential arrangements.

stories.title: Tetsuya Naito Free Kochi Appearance Ahead of NOAH Return
stories.tldr: Tetsuya Naito will make a free public appearance in Kochi on October 10 to promote Pro Wrestling NOAH's upcoming Lethal Odyssey tour stop in the city. The promotional event will take place on a special stage outside JR Kochi Station ahead of NOAH's first show in the region in nearly seven years. Naito continues to be a major focus for the promotion, with top stars like Kaito Kiyomiya targeting him as a key part of their career comebacks.

stories.title: Mandy Rose Speaks on Close Bond with TNA Star Elayna Black
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Mandy Rose recently opened up about her close relationship with TNA wrestler Elayna Black, whom she now considers a little sister. The two bonded during their time together in WWE, and their friendship grew stronger when Black reached out to Rose for guidance shortly before her departure from the company in 2025. Rose immediately connected Black with her own management team, helping pave the way for Black's successful transition to the independent circuit and her subsequent signing with TNA in January 2026. Additionally, Rose praised Black for launching an adult content stream for extra income, noting that she smarty utilized her built-in wrestling following in a manner similar to Rose's own career path.

stories.title: Missy Hyatt Auctions Off Breast Implant for $2,000
stories.tldr: Professional wrestling legend Missy Hyatt recently made headlines by auctioning off one of her actual breast implants to a fan. The unique piece of memorabilia came complete with a certificate of authenticity signed by her doctor, alongside Hyatt's own signature. Bidding started at $1,500 and ultimately concluded when a fan named Brad C secured the item for $2,000. In addition to this unusual auction, Hyatt recently made a surprise appearance at Joey Janela’s Spring Break during Sandman’s retirement match.

stories.title: Shawn Phoenix and Brutus Dylan Announced for RCW Revolution Rumble
stories.tldr: Revolution Championship Wrestling has announced the next six participants for its upcoming 2026 Revolution Rumble. Highlighting the new batch of entrants are Shawn Phoenix and Brutus Dylan, who enters the match following his role in restoring the RCW name. The 30-person over-the-top-rope style match takes place on September 27 in Mishawaka, Indiana, with the winner securing a future RCW Heavyweight Championship opportunity.

stories.title: Grindhouse Pro Wrestling Returning to Jeffersonville on September 27
stories.tldr: Grindhouse Pro Wrestling is heading back to its home arena in Jeffersonville, Indiana, for a live afternoon event on Sunday, September 27. The family-friendly show features a 3 p.m. bell time and is scheduled to run until 6 p.m. at the promotion's Spring Street venue. While specific matches and talent have not yet been announced, tickets are currently available for purchase online and through promotional channels.

stories.title: MCW Pro Wrestling Sets Bruiser Strong Championship Battle Royal
stories.tldr: MCW Pro Wrestling is hosting its upcoming Bruiser Strong event on Saturday, September 26, at the RJ Meyer Arena in Joppa, Maryland. The headline attraction is an 11-person battle royal for the MCW Heavyweight Championship, paying tribute to RJ The Bruiser Meyer and his 11 title reigns. The loaded card also features multiple championship bouts, an I Quit match, and various singles clashes. Tickets are currently available ranging from individual seats to a family package.

stories.title: Perry Saturn Recalls Confrontation with Mike Graham in WCW
stories.tldr: Former WCW star Perry Saturn recently opened up about the explosive final days of his tenure with the company and the formation of the legendary group known as The Radicalz. Saturn explained how a chaotic backstage environment under booker Vince Russo, combined with friction against agents like Kevin Sullivan and Mike Graham, pushed him, Chris Benoit, Dean Malenko, and Eddie Guerrero to seek their release in 2000. The situation reached a boiling point when a heavily intoxicated Mike Graham allegedly pulled a knife on Saturn in Cincinnati, prompting Saturn to involve local law enforcement and Time Warner Human Resources. This police intervention ultimately sealed the group's departure, leading directly to their high profile jump to WWE.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett Scheduled to Wrestle at Pig Fest in October
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Jeff Jarrett is scheduled to make an in-ring return at an upcoming event in Hendersonville, Tennessee. He will headline the All-Star Super Slam at Pig Fest, taking place at Veterans Park on Thursday, October 22, from 7:30 p.m. to 9:30 p.m. While his opponent has not yet been named, the promotion is billing the appearance as a special homecoming for Jarrett. Tickets are currently on sale with prices starting at $17.85.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Thunder Hosting Free Show at Bluffton Street Fair
stories.tldr: Pro Wrestling Thunder is holding a free live wrestling event at the Bluffton Street Fair on Friday, September 25, starting at 7 p.m. Sponsored by Barkley Properties, the show will feature promotion ring announcer Boomer WMEE. While individual matches have not yet been announced, the event follows PWT's recent digital expansion on YouTube, which included the second episode of Thunder Vision featuring Leela Feist versus Mika.

stories.title: Perry Saturn Says He Wouldn't Have Left WCW If Eric Bischoff Stayed
stories.tldr: Former WCW star Perry Saturn recently revealed in an interview that he would have never left World Championship Wrestling if Eric Bischoff had not been fired from his position as company president in September 1999. Saturn praised Bischoff for taking care of him and noted that the entire mid-card locker room shared this sentiment despite some frustrations with booking and a heavy grueling schedule. Ultimately, Saturn and his peers departed the company largely due to residual heat stemming from the real-life backstage tension between Chris Benoit and booker Kevin Sullivan.

stories.title: NORTH Wrestling Announces Thunderstruck 4 in Newcastle upon Tyne
stories.tldr: NORTH Wrestling has officially announced its upcoming Thunderstruck 4 event, scheduled for Saturday, October 24, at the Walker Dome in Newcastle upon Tyne. Listed on the promotion calendar as event NCL.72, the all-ages show will feature a 6 p.m. start time preceded by early doors and a special meet-and-greet session. Fans planning their visit to the Wharrier Street venue can secure their entry through the official ticketing page. As is standard for live wrestling events, the final match card and advertised talent lineup remain subject to change.

stories.title: Former WWE Star Viktor Returning for Rebel's ALS Benefit Match
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Viktor officially concluded his in-ring career with a special final match against Dalton Castle at a Dream Pro Wrestling benefit event. Truth Magnum revealed that Viktor was already preparing to retire, but readily agreed to return to the ring to support Tanea Rebel Brooks in her battle against ALS. The Louisville event ultimately sold out and raised over seven thousand dollars for I AM ALS in Rebel honor. This meaningful gathering allowed Viktor to reunite with old OVW friends and make one final contribution for a deeply personal cause.

stories.title: Paul Walter Hauser Advertised for PROGRESS Chapter 198
stories.tldr: Actor and wrestling personality Paul Walter Hauser is officially advertised to appear at PROGRESS Wrestling Chapter 198: When September Ends at London’s Electric Ballroom. The September 27 event marks the promotion's return to Camden following its Odyssey Tour around Britain. Hauser is currently listed as the reigning Proteus Champion on the official roster, though no specific opponent or title defense has been announced yet. The event is family-friendly and operates under the new leadership of Big Damo and Nikki Cross, who acquired the promotion earlier this year.

stories.title: RevPro and CMLL Announce Fantastica Mania UK Doubleheader
stories.tldr: Revolution Pro Wrestling and CMLL have announced a doubleheader for their third annual Fantastica Mania UK event, scheduled for Saturday, October 17, at The Hangar in Wolverhampton. The full-day extravaganza will feature top wrestling talent from both Mexico and Britain competing across separate afternoon and evening cards. Fans can purchase discounted combination tickets that grant access to both shows, though specific matches and talent lineups have not yet been revealed by the promotion. This UK collaboration is part of a broader global presence for the Fantastica Mania banner, following a separate NJPW and CMLL crossover event held in Mexico in June.

stories.title: Conor Mills vs. Kuro Undisputed British Title Match Set for Paris
stories.tldr: Revolution Pro Wrestling and APC are joining forces for a major weekend of events at Studio Jenny in Nanterre, France, on September 26 and 27. The marquee bout features Conor Mills challenging Kuro for the Undisputed British Heavyweight Championship on the Sunday RevPro Live in Paris card. The cross-promotional weekend also highlights several other high-profile matches and talent, showcasing the strong partnership between the two promotions.

stories.title: Roddy Piper and Wendi Richter Among IPWHF Class of 2026
stories.tldr: The International Professional Wrestling Hall of Fame has announced its Class of 2026 inductees, featuring legendary names such as Roddy Piper, Wendi Richter, and Tommy Rich. The upcoming induction ceremony is scheduled for November 1 in Albany, New York, at the museum located inside the MVP Arena. Fans attending the event will enjoy private museum access, refreshments, and opportunities to see several wrestling legends receive their rings. Supporter reservations are priced at fifty dollars and include commemorative items along with a chance to meet notable figures from the industry.

stories.title: Mickie James Suffers Minor Eye Injury, Misses Hamilton Comic Con
stories.tldr: Former wrestling champion Mickie James was forced to cancel her scheduled appearance at Hamilton Comic Con after suffering a minor eye injury at her farm. She issued an apology to her fans on social media, explaining that the pain, bright lights, and travel made it impossible for her to attend. Other wrestling legends including Brett The Hitman Hart, Candice Michelle, and Gail Kim were also part of the convention lineup. Meanwhile, James recently shared backstage details regarding a past WWE debut idea involving CM Punk.

stories.title: Shaul Guerrero Recovers from Dislocated Hip After 14 Hours in ER
stories.tldr: Shaul Guerrero is currently recovering at home after suffering a painful dislocated hip during a burlesque performance last week. Her husband, TNA Wrestling commentator Matthew Rehwoldt, shared the harrowing experience on social media, detailing that the injury required two attempts to reset her hip and resulted in a grueling fourteen-hour wait in the emergency room. Guerrero, who performs as Miss Nyxon in the burlesque scene, is well known to wrestling fans as former WWE talent Raquel Diaz and as a former AEW ring announcer, as well as the daughter of WWE Hall of Famer Eddie Guerrero.

stories.title: MLW Announces April 2027 Return Taping in Charleston
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling has officially announced its return to Charleston, South Carolina, scheduled for Saturday, April 10, 2027. The event will take place at Festival Hall and serve as a television taping for MLW Fusion, which recently secured a weekly Thursday-night streaming home on Tubi. Tickets start at 10 dollars and go on sale September 16 through MLWGo.com and Eventbrite, following a company announcement made on September 14. While specific matches and talent have not yet been revealed, the promotion promises championship bouts and appearances by both established stars and rising contenders in front of what is expected to be another sold-out hometown crowd.

stories.title: Netflix Sets October Premiere Date for Mike Tyson Documentary
stories.tldr: Netflix has announced an October 13 premiere date for a new four-part documentary series titled TYSON, focusing on the life and career of the boxing legend. Directed by Floyd Russ, the project features candid interviews with Tyson and those close to him to explore his Brooklyn upbringing, championship success, and well-documented personal controversies. Beyond his combat sports legacy, Tyson also holds a prominent place in professional wrestling history as a 2012 WWE Hall of Fame inductee. His famous involvement in Steve Austin's WrestleMania XIV championship victory continues to be celebrated as a defining generational moment for the company.

stories.title: KC Navarro and Fabian Aichner Tagging on TNA Xplosion
stories.tldr: KC Navarro and Fabian Aichner are joining forces for a special tag team match against KPK on the upcoming episode of TNA Xplosion. Fans can catch the exclusive match first on TNA+ this Friday before it becomes available for free on YouTube the following Tuesday. The weekly series also features regular highlights like the Trending Topics and classic vault segments, alongside new broader distribution plans.

stories.title: NWA Announces Double Powerrr Tapings in Tampa for November
stories.tldr: The National Wrestling Alliance is heading back to Tampa, Florida, on November 21 for a pair of NWA Powerrr television tapings at WEDU PBS Studios. Fans can catch the 2 p.m. and 7 p.m. shows, which will highlight the fallout from the recent Samhain event. Affordable ticket options include fourteen dollars and ninety-five cents for a single show or twenty-four dollars and ninety-five cents for a double feature. A loaded roster of champions and top stars is advertised to appear, though the lineup remains subject to change.

stories.title: AJ Francis to Host Houston Hardy Party Featuring Queen Sharmell
stories.tldr: TNA has announced that AJ Francis will host the upcoming Houston Hardy Party on September 22 at Pitch 25, alongside special appearances by Queen Sharmell and guests from Reality of Wrestling. The event, which features wrestling legends Matt and Jeff Hardy, offers multiple ticket tiers including VIP, priority, and general admission options. Fans attending the intimate gathering will experience a live question and answer session, photo opportunities, and autograph signings depending on their ticket package.

stories.title: Gisele Shaw Relinquishes MLP Canadian Title After NWA Signing
stories.tldr: Gisele Shaw recently dropped the MLP Women’s Canadian Championship to Priscilla Kelly following her exclusive contract signing with the National Wrestling Alliance. Reports indicate that Shaw was initially planned to hold the title until October, but her new NWA deal prevents her from appearing on television for other promotions. Despite a previous split with MLP owner Scott D'Amore, D'Amore continued to book her strongly as the face of the women's division until her departure. Shaw now moves forward as the reigning NWA World Women’s Television Champion.

stories.title: Steph De Lander Compares Creative Freedom in WWE, TNA, and ROH
stories.tldr: Steph De Lander recently discussed the varying levels of creative freedom across Ring of Honor, TNA, and WWE during an interview with TMZ Sports Inside The Ring. She expressed immense gratitude for returning from a neck injury to wrestle on Ring of Honor television and pay-per-views so quickly. While she praised the collaborative creative environments in both Ring of Honor and TNA, she noted that WWE operates with much stricter creative restraints due to its massive scale.

stories.title: Update on Tessa Blanchard Contractual Situation Involving MLW and CMLL
stories.tldr: Tessa Blanchard's planned MLW debut recently fell through amid complicated backstage circumstances. New reports reveal that CMLL representatives were actually present on the interview call when Blanchard announced a long-term MLW signing, which directly contradicted her agreed-upon one-off status. This miscommunication highlights ongoing tensions regarding her dual commitments, following her departure from TNA earlier this year over similar scheduling conflicts.

stories.title: Kevin Knight comments on working in AEW and wrestling tribalism
stories.tldr: AEW star Kevin Knight recently opened up about the surreal experience of working alongside his childhood wrestling idols and achieving success in Tony Khan's promotion. He also addressed the internet tribalism between WWE and AEW fans, comparing it to sports rivalries while highlighting the strong network of support among Black wrestlers across both companies. Knight emphasized that Black talent is setting a powerful new standard in the industry today, proving they are no longer anomalies.

stories.title: Mike Bailey discusses his road to wrestling and comparing it to live action movies
stories.tldr: Speedball Mike Bailey believes professional wrestling offers fans an experience unlike any other form of entertainment. Professional wrestling has long been compared to scripted forms of entertainment such as movies and television, but Bailey views it as something closer to watching an action movie

stories.title: Young Bucks discuss gear easter eggs from AEW All In 2026
stories.tldr: The Young Bucks recently discussed the intricate easter eggs hidden in their legacy-themed ring gear worn during their match against Adam Copeland and Christian Cage at AEW All In London 2026 at Wembley Stadium. During an episode of Being The Elite, Matt and Nick Jackson explained that their jackets and tights featured tributes to various promotions, former foes, and pivotal career moments. The gear showcased logos from companies they worked for like ROH, PWG, Dragon Gate, CHIKARA, and EWF, alongside personal milestones such as the original 2018 All In event, Bullet Club, and their EVP era in AEW.

stories.title: AEW Collision ticket sales update for Charleston
stories.tldr: AEW is hosting tonight's episode of Collision at the Charleston Coliseum in West Virginia with 2,132 tickets distributed so far. This marks a minor increase of 27 tickets over the past day, though it trails behind the 3,403 tickets drawn for a Dynamite event at the same venue in April 2024. Fans looking to attend can still find standard admission tickets starting at $29.60, along with approximately 54 tickets currently available on the resale market.

stories.title: Match announcements and build for AEW All Out and Tailgate Brawl
stories.tldr: Following his successful title defense, AEW National Champion Andrade El Idolo was challenged to a pay-per-view match by PAC. Additionally, the All Out Tailgate Brawl pre-show card has expanded with a high-stakes 10-man tag team match and a singles clash between Jack Perry and Katsuyori Shibata. These new bouts round out a loaded lineup for the upcoming Chicago event.

stories.title: Kota Ibushi provides concerning update on health and femur injury
stories.tldr: AEW star Kota Ibushi recently underwent a second surgery to replace weak plates in his fractured femur following an injury sustained against Josh Alexander. In an emotional social media update, Ibushi revealed that he has been taking cancer medication for the past year and is currently unsure if he will ever wrestle again. His immediate focus is simply regaining his health and becoming a normal person, though he has already managed to transition from a wheelchair to crutches.

stories.title: Steve Borden cuts first promo in AEW
stories.tldr: Following his recent introduction to AEW audiences, Steve Borden officially cut his very first promo for the company on the September 19, 2026 episode of Collision. After Darby Allin successfully defended his TNT Championship against Myron Reed, Allin proposed that he and Borden team up to pursue the AEW World Tag Team Championship at All Out. Borden accepted the challenge in a concise and direct address to the fans, making it clear he intends to chase championship gold rather than treat the partnership as a one-night novelty.

stories.title: Speculation on former WWE stars signing with AEW
stories.tldr: Following earlier departures, recent AEW events have featured the debut of Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed as The New Level. Speculation continues to grow around additional talent acquisitions heading toward late 2026. Reports indicate that Ilja Dragunov is already AEW bound, while discussions are also underway with Kairi Sane and consideration is being given to Sheamus.

stories.title: Ranking AEW's stacked trios division
stories.tldr: Following their title win at All In, Swerve Strickland and the New Level find themselves at the center of a suddenly stacked AEW trios division. A massive wave of former champions and top contenders, including Hangman Page and Brodido, The Demand, and the Death Riders, are all positioning themselves for shots at the gold. The crowded landscape promises a busy championship picture heading into All Out and beyond.

stories.title: Kenny Omega discusses aging and future in AEW after All In
stories.tldr: Following his AEW World Championship loss to Will Ospreay at All In, Kenny Omega has addressed his future and physical condition during an appearance at the Tokyo Game Show. Omega admitted that the grueling Wembley Stadium main event was perhaps the hardest match of his career as he navigates the aging process. However, the former champion assured fans that he gave everything he had and that this defeat is certainly not the end of his career. While he has not appeared on AEW television since the event, Omega remains proud of the historic encounter and plans to return.

stories.title: WWE and AEW contracts expiring soon including Dragon Lee and Dralistico
stories.tldr: The contracts of real life brothers Dragon Lee in WWE and Dralistico in AEW are nearing their expiration dates, and the duo has recently filed to trademark the name Hermanos Lee. Reports indicate that at least four additional unnamed Latin wrestlers across both major promotions also have deals coming due between October and February. This wave of upcoming expirations could set the stage for significant roster shifts and potential reunions in the near future.

stories.title: AJ Styles' podcast comes to an end
stories.tldr: After just seven months, The AJ Styles Show podcast has officially come to an end. Co-host and producer Tony Giles announced the closure on X, confirming that past episodes will remain available while the channel is rebranded into a video game-focused show called The Loose Cart Podcast hosted by Giles and John Riggs. No specific reason was given for the abrupt shutdown, though Giles clarified that he and Styles remain good friends.

stories.title: Bayley celebrates 18 years in professional wrestling
stories.tldr: WWE star Bayley is celebrating the 18th anniversary of her professional wrestling career, marking the exact length of time she had been alive when she first stepped into the ring. She shared a heartfelt statement on Instagram expressing gratitude for her journey, her travels, and her continued passion for the industry. The milestone arrives as Bayley recently returned to WWE television following a brief hiatus that followed a feud and a series of matches with Lyra Valkyria.

stories.title: AJ Styles recalls opening WrestleMania 35 and winning WWE Title from Jon Moxley
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently reflected on several major moments from his WWE career during an interview. He discussed his WrestleMania 35 singles match against Randy Orton, revealing that their bout suffered because a stadium spotlight blinded the live crowd and because Brock Lesnar altered the show order to open the event instead. Styles also praised Orton as a generational talent who embodies the WWE brand. Additionally, Styles looked back on winning his first WWE Championship from Dean Ambrose, now known in AEW as Jon Moxley, at Backlash 2016.

stories.title: Chelsea Green on WWE return and family plans with Matt Cardona
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green and Matt Cardona were actively planning to start a family when WWE unexpectedly reached out to rehire Green, forcing them to temporarily put those plans on hold. Because pregnancy would require an immediate halt to her demanding wrestling career, Green is currently focusing on her in-ring success while also actively auditioning for acting roles to build a Hollywood resume. This strategic preparation will allow her the flexibility to transition away from wrestling to have children and later return to either entertainment industry on her own terms. Matt Cardona is fully supportive of her timeline, giving her the space to navigate this busy chapter of her career.

stories.title: Matt Cardona teases Royal Rumble return following injury
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona recently underwent surgery for a torn triceps injury that brought his recent WWE momentum to a sudden halt. Despite the severe setback, Cardona is already planning to beat the recovery timetable provided by surgeons. During a recent appearance with Chelsea Green on Katie Nolan's show, he even teased a potential surprise comeback at the Royal Rumble.

stories.title: Matt Cardona talks about getting released from WWE
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona recently reflected on his 2020 WWE release, calling it the greatest day of his life because it forced him to evolve beyond his Zack Ryder persona. Spending fifteen years with the company from age 20 to 35 left him needing a drastic change to find his true identity. By hitting the independent circuit and reinventing himself globally, he successfully established the Matt Cardona character. Even after his wife Chelsea Green returned to WWE, Cardona continued his solo evolution, proving his reinvention was built to last.

stories.title: Brooke Havok reportedly set for WWE ID deal after SummerSlam tryouts
stories.tldr: Independent wrestler Brooke Havok was reportedly set to receive a WWE ID deal following her performance at the company tryouts during SummerSlam weekend in early August 2026. However, her promising career momentum hit a major roadblock when she announced on September 11 that she requires surgery for a torn ACL and meniscus. It currently remains unconfirmed whether she officially signed the agreement before sustaining the injury, though internal WWE sources indicated strong plans were in place for her.

stories.title: Speculation on WWE vintage factions returning
stories.tldr: Wrestling fans always enjoy a good throwback, and two classic WWE factions from the past could easily make a successful return with a modern twist in 2026. The controversial moral guardians Right to Censor could be reimagined to target today's social media landscape, potentially backed by current stars like Zoey Stark and Liv Morgan. Meanwhile, a spooky supernatural revival inspired by the Ministry of Darkness could be led by dark-themed talent such as Alexa Bliss, Tatum Paxley, and Shiloh Hill. Both concepts offer fresh ways to shake up current rosters and feud with established groups like The Judgment Day.

stories.title: Trick Williams describes life on the road with Lash Legend
stories.tldr: WWE stars Trick Williams and Lash Legend, who married earlier this summer in Jamaica, have opened up about their life and careers on the road together following their transition to the SmackDown brand. Williams credits his wife and best friend for significantly boosting his career trajectory, noting she challenged him early on to put on 30 pounds to help him look like a future heavyweight champion. In return, Williams provides mental, emotional, and respectful professional support to help Legend thrive alongside him on the main roster as she teams up with Nia Jax.

stories.title: Backstage updates on recent WWE tryouts in Minneapolis
stories.tldr: WWE recently held tryouts in Minneapolis ahead of SummerSlam, with several participants now positioned for potential contracts or developmental deals. Among them, indie standout Brooke Havok was internally slated for an offer or WWE ID agreement before suffering an unfortunate ACL injury. Additionally, other tryout attendees J-Rod and Joshua Bishop have attracted outside attention after recently visiting TNA Wrestling television tapings in Chicago.

stories.title: Baron Corbin discusses WWE SummerSlam career goal
stories.tldr: Baron Corbin recently opened up about why he considered WWE SummerSlam to be the white whale of his career due to past bad luck and missed opportunities at the event. Despite having high-profile matches against John Cena and Finn Balor in the past, various planned bouts fell through over the years. He finally checked this major career goal off his list by defeating Trick Williams to win the United States Championship at this year's event in Minnesota. However, his championship reign was short-lived as he lost the title back to Williams the following month.

stories.title: Nick Khan praises Triple H and addresses WWE social media feedback
stories.tldr: WWE President Nick Khan recently addressed the social media criticism the company has faced regarding ticket prices, ring mat sponsorships, and creative directions following partnerships with TKO Holdings and Netflix. Speaking with The Varsity, Khan explained that while WWE occasionally takes valid critiques into account, the company consciously avoids reacting to most online grievances to prevent skewed decision making. Instead, Khan expressed full confidence in WWE's internal team, specifically praising Paul Levesque, known as Triple H, as the best booker in the wrestling industry. Despite ongoing fan complaints, Khan remains proud of the substantial growth experienced by WWE and other TKO-umbrella entities like On Location, IMG, and PBR.

stories.title: Blake Monroe claims credit for Giulia's recent spotlight in WWE
stories.tldr: Blake Monroe is publicly claiming responsibility for Giulia enjoying her highest level of relevance and media attention since arriving in WWE. Despite the two being locked in an intense rivalry that has escalated since Monroe debuted on SmackDown, they have yet to square off in an official match. Monroe dismisses Giulia ignoring her in interviews as a facade and threatens to inflict severe pain on her rival ahead of a major qualifying match, comparing the impending beating to painful dental surgery.

stories.title: John Cena referenced by Drake on new song FOMO
stories.tldr: Drake referenced WWE legend John Cena on an unreleased track called I Know What's True from his upcoming project FOMO. During a YouTube livestream, the rapper rapped the line, Chrome belt, look like John Cena in here, while showing off his luxury jewelry. The lyric serves as a nod to Cena's iconic spinning championship belt from his mid-2000s Doctor of Thuganomics era. This marks the latest crossover between the hip-hop superstar and professional wrestling culture.

stories.title: JBL praises legendary career of longtime WWE star
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer JBL recently offered high praise for former world champion The Miz, declaring that he has enjoyed one of the most remarkable careers in professional wrestling history. Speaking on a podcast, JBL highlighted The Miz's incredible versatility, relentless work ethic, and ability to be trusted in various roles by the company. JBL particularly emphasized the unique nature of The Miz's success because he entered the industry through a reality show rather than traditional territory training.

stories.title: Nick Khan details WWE Netflix viewership data expectations
stories.tldr: WWE President Nick Khan recently discussed the kind of viewership data the company expects to analyze following its landmark move to Netflix. While public Netflix charts only reveal limited weekly top 10 data, WWE higher-ups are seeking comprehensive metrics including live viewership, 24-hour views, and weekly totals. Khan emphasized that wrestling is uniquely suited for delayed viewing because fans follow intricate storylines rather than just final match results. Additionally, Khan highlighted how international event locations impact regional viewership, reinforcing WWE's transformation into a true global entertainment company.

stories.title: Big E discusses meditation and managing depression during WWE career
stories.tldr: Former WWE Champion Big E recently shared his lifelong battle with major depressive disorder and psychotic features during a TEDx talk titled How I Got Over. He explained how committing to a daily meditation practice during the COVID-19 pandemic helped him manage his mental health, quiet negative thoughts, and find a renewed sense of agency. This mental resilience ultimately helped him cope with the severe neck injury that ended his in-ring wrestling career, allowing him to replace resentment with gratitude and acceptance. The inspiring talk shares its title with his forthcoming memoir.

stories.title: WWE impressed by talent at Colombia tryouts
stories.tldr: WWE recently evaluated promising athletic prospects during tryouts in Bogota, Colombia, led by industry veterans William Regal and Matt Bloom. The standout group of potential recruits heavily features athletes from Chile, including a national fencer and Miss Universe contestant, a champion hammer thrower, a former NFL player, and an experienced independent wrestler. WWE officials plan to continue scouting regional talent at the upcoming South American Games.

stories.title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026 qualifiers and card build
stories.tldr: Recent television broadcasts have added major names to the Money in the Bank fields while setting up high-profile grudge matches and title defenses for the October event. Trick Williams defeated Rey Fenix and Randy Orton to secure his spot on the men's side, while Jacy Jayne punched her ticket for the women's match by overcoming Alexa Bliss and Jade Cargill. Meanwhile, backstage tensions are boiling over with Baron Corbin targeting Williams, Cody Rhodes plotting against Randy Orton, and a potential triple threat brewing for the Undisputed WWE Championship.

stories.title: Botched finish during Sami Zayn vs. Kevin Owens SmackDown match
stories.tldr: Following the chaotic SmackDown main event where Sami Zayn retained his title over Kevin Owens with help from CM Punk, backstage reports have clarified the bizarre, botched finish. Contrary to online speculation that Owens missed a scheduled kickout, sources confirm the match was actually supposed to end immediately on the initial three-count following the belt shot. When the referee failed to call for the ring bell, Zayn and Owens were forced to improvise on the fly, leading to a scramble that culminated in a second Helluva Kick and a definitive pin.

stories.title: Jim Johnston reflects on WWE entrance music and modern themes
stories.tldr: Legendary composer Jim Johnston recently reflected on his iconic WWE career, sharing how he initially doubted whether Vince McMahon and Shawn Michaels would approve of the risky D-Generation X entrance theme. In a recent interview, Johnston also argued that wrestlers do not necessarily understand their own characters best and should not pick their own music based on personal taste. Furthermore, he criticized modern wrestling themes as generic noise, claiming that the lack of distinctive character-driven scores is hindering the creation of massive crossover stars like The Rock or Stone Cold Steve Austin.

stories.title: Mason Rook on his WWE NXT look and John Cena praise
stories.tldr: Mason Rook has addressed online criticism regarding his physical appearance while navigating his journey in WWE NXT. Meanwhile, John Cena has shared detailed stories about how he first discovered Rook on television overseas before meeting him backstage at a UK event. Cena continues to champion the young star, praising his in-ring storytelling and hinting at a potential spot for him in the upcoming John Cena Classic.

stories.title: Full card confirmed for WWE x AAA Worlds Collide
stories.tldr: The complete match card and special appearances for the upcoming WWE and AAA crossover event have been officially revealed. Highlighted by a blockbuster six-man tag team main event involving CM Punk, Rey Mysterio, and El Grande Americano against Omos, Dominik Mysterio, and JD McDonagh, the stacked lineup features multiple championship matches and cross-promotional showdowns. NXT standout Oba Femi is also officially scheduled to make a special appearance at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois.

stories.title: Teams revealed for WWE NXT 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: Six additional teams have been confirmed for the upcoming 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic, which kicks off this Tuesday on NXT. The newly announced participants include BirthRight, Mini Vikingo and Starboy Charlie, Fraxiom, DarkState, Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno, and Los Americanos. Furthermore, NXT Tag Team Champions The Vanity Project and AAA Tag Team Champions The Wagner Brothers have secured first-round byes in the tournament.

stories.title: Unaired WWE SmackDown footage of Cody Rhodes talking about Randy Orton
stories.tldr: Following his controversial refusal to punt Randy Orton, Cody Rhodes addressed fan criticism during a sit-down interview on SmackDown. However, newly released unaired footage shows a much more aggressive side to the champion. Off-air, Rhodes whispered a chilling warning that he will not hesitate to violently retaliate next time.

stories.title: Backstage reaction to Sami Zayn winning the WWE Championship
stories.tldr: Sami Zayn recently captured the Undisputed WWE Championship from CM Punk on SmackDown to set up a major match against Roman Reigns. However, new backstage reports reveal that the surprising decision was not universally supported behind the scenes. Management reportedly insists the polarizing title change will make strategic sense as the storylines develop toward upcoming international events.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano addresses fan speculation about her sexuality
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Zoey Serrano recently addressed long-running fan speculation regarding her sexuality, confirming that she is straight while enthusiastically embracing her status as an LGBTQ+ ally. Speaking in a new interview, she attributed the rumors to her time aligned with Sonya Deville and Shayna Baszler in the Pure Fusion Collective. Additionally, Serrano opened up about a stressful health scare involving a blocked salivary gland that occurred right before her memorable Raw main event against Becky Lynch.

stories.title: Simone Johnson reflects on her WWE career and fan perspective
stories.tldr: Simone Johnson recently opened up about how her father Dwayne The Rock Johnson's return to WWE in early 2024 directly impacted her on-screen run in NXT. Appearing on Cody Rhodes podcast, she revealed that fan backlash from that storyline permanently altered her perspective on the wrestling business. Johnson ultimately departed WWE in January 2026 to begin a new chapter as a junior executive at Seven Bucks Productions.

stories.title: Possible future WWE World Tag Team Champions
stories.tldr: Bron Breakker and Austin Theory currently hold the WWE World Tag Team Championship as part of The Vision following their July victory. Analysts have identified four potential challenger tandems aiming to dethrone the champions. These groups include the newly debuted 946, Alpha Academy, and dynamic pairings featuring LA Knight alongside either Solo Sikoa or Oba Femi.

stories.title: Six WWE stars who could win first main roster championship
stories.tldr: Building on the discussion of rising WWE talent eyeing their first main roster titles, specific names like Oba Femi, Bronson Reed, and recent signee Kyoki have emerged as leading contenders. Creative plans are also pointing toward a new women's tag team pairing for Jordynne Grace and Ivy Nile, while young standout Je'Von Evans has multiple paths to historic title reigns.
