These developing storylines highlight the company's focus on elevating fresh faces into the championship picture across Raw and SmackDown.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live discusses Sami Zayn, MITB, and CMLL
stories.tldr: Ian Carey recently filled in to break down Sami Zayn's championship run and early speculation surrounding potential Money in the Bank winners. The discussion also covered the latest updates on Tessa Blanchard and Major League Wrestling alongside a review of recent SmackDown action. Additionally, the show highlighted the upcoming CMLL 93rd Anniversary event during a busy week of professional wrestling news.

stories.title: Natalya aspires to be modern day Fabulous Moolah in WWE
stories.tldr: Natalya is continuing to evolve her gritty new character following her recent television appearances. Speaking about her creative future, she revealed that she would love to become a dominant mega heel modeled after Fabulous Moolah. However, she noted that executing such a massive character shift requires total alignment from creative and the locker room.

stories.title: WWE creative plans heading into WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia
stories.tldr: Creative plans are already taking shape for WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia, headlined by potential blockbuster matches for the World Heavyweight and Undisputed WWE Championships. Speculation points to Roman Reigns facing Oba Femi for the World Heavyweight title, while several high-profile scenarios are being weighed for the Undisputed championship. Potential main events feature Sami Zayn, Cody Rhodes, CM Punk, Randy Orton, Drew McIntyre, and rising star Trick Williams.

stories.title: Directions for potential Cody Rhodes heel turn in WWE
stories.tldr: Following his refusal to punt Randy Orton at Sunday Night's Main Event, Cody Rhodes addressed ongoing heel turn speculation in a sit-down interview with Michael Cole on SmackDown. As anticipation for a character change reaches an all-time high, analysts have outlined four potential directions for the American Nightmare. These creative avenues range from an obsessive heel championship chase and a tag team alliance with Ricky Saints to retiring Randy Orton or finally aligning with The Rock.

stories.title: Nikki Bella reflects on WWE SmackDown match with Paige
stories.tldr: Nikki Bella recently defeated Paige in a surprisingly brief singles match on SmackDown following their SummerSlam betrayal. On her podcast, Nikki revealed she was originally surprised the long-awaited encounter wasn't booked for a premium live event. Despite the short match, she was thrilled with their massive social media engagement and the storyline heat generated in Mexico City. Looking ahead, Nikki has set her sights on challenging for the Interim WWE Women's Championship, claiming her veteran status bypasses the need for a qualifier.

stories.title: Bronson Reed addresses cause of his torn biceps injury
stories.tldr: Bronson Reed has identified accumulated wear and tear from years of heavy powerlifting, along with pushing for a personal record on bicep curls, as the likely causes of his torn biceps injury. The WWE Raw star admitted that rebuilding his strength during recovery was the hardest part, especially after watching his right arm lose significant size initially. Reed has now successfully returned to television alongside The Vision and is immediately setting his sights on Oba Femi.

stories.title: Wren Sinclair discusses NXT frustrations and Kendal Grey injury
stories.tldr: Wren Sinclair expressed deep frustration on Busted Open Radio regarding her nearly three years in NXT without proper opportunities or recognition despite following all the rules. She compared her harsh storyline suspension for accidentally hitting a referee to preferential treatment given to others. Sinclair also shared additional context on Kendal Grey, noting that Grey refuses to accept the severity of her vestibular issues and continues pushing past her limits.

stories.title: Backstage producers revealed for WWE Raw in Mexico City
stories.tldr: Following the recent WWE Raw event in Mexico City, backstage producer assignments for the September 14 episode have been revealed. Internally titled Once Upon a Time in Mexico, the show featured high-profile bouts including a World Heavyweight Championship defense and multiple Money in the Bank qualifiers. Fightful Select has now released the complete list detailing which producers mapped out each specific match and segment on the card.

stories.title: Matches and segments confirmed for WWE RAW on Netflix
stories.tldr: WWE has revealed the matches and segments for next week's upcoming episode of Monday Night Raw on Netflix in San Antonio, Texas. The broadcast will feature triple threat matches to determine more Money in the Bank ladder match competitors, including Dragon Lee versus Solo Sikoa versus Dominik Mysterio for the men, and La Catalina versus Roxanne Perez versus IYO SKY for the women. Additionally, LA Knight is scheduled to address the fans during a live promo segment on the show.

stories.title: AAA on FOX updates and Dorian Roldan announcement
stories.tldr: The latest episode of AAA on FOX served as the fallout from TripleMania 34, featuring major announcements regarding upcoming events and company storylines. Dorian Roldan revealed plans for a Hall of Fame induction, an investigation into Rey Mysterio, and a future big announcement, while General Manager Rey Mysterio unveiled new matches for the upcoming Worlds Collide event in Chicago. Additionally, the promotion confirmed the match card for the September 26 weekly broadcast.

stories.title: DDP reflects on WCW career, contracts, and Roddy Piper friendship
stories.tldr: WCW legend Diamond Dallas Page recently reflected on his storied career during a podcast appearance, revealing that he accepted significantly lower pay during his peak 1997 and 1998 run just to live out his wrestling dream. He also discussed his disappointing WWE debut during the Invasion angle, noting that his poorly received stalker storyline with The Undertaker alienated former WCW fans and caused them to stop watching. Additionally, Page shared fond memories of his close post-wrestling friendship with the late Roddy Piper, who bonded with him deeply over his life-saving rehabilitation work with Jake Roberts.

stories.title: IWGP Tag Team Title match set for NJPW Road To King of Pro-Wrestling
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro-Wrestling has officially announced an IWGP Tag Team Championship match for the upcoming Road to King of Pro-Wrestling tour. Champions HENARE and Great-O-Khan will defend their titles against the Knockout Brothers, featuring OSKAR and Yuto-Ice, on October 6 at Korakuen Hall. The challengers earned this opportunity following a chaotic and bloody main event victory during the Battle Line Hokkaido series. This upcoming bout serves as a deeply personal rematch stemming from a controversial title loss at Dominion back in June.

stories.title: NJPW announces full card for Destruction in Kobe
stories.tldr: New Japan Pro-Wrestling has officially revealed the complete fight card for the upcoming Destruction in Kobe event scheduled for September 27. The massive show will be headlined by Yota Tsuji putting his IWGP Heavyweight Championship on the line against veteran challenger Hirooki Goto. Additionally, the co-main event features a high-stakes clash with Gabe Kidd defending the IWGP Global Heavyweight Title against Drilla Moloney. Fans can also look forward to an action-packed undercard filled with championship matches and marquee special singles bouts.

stories.title: Jordynne Grace returns to bodybuilding competition
stories.tldr: TNA star Jordynne Grace made a surprise return to the bodybuilding stage at the IBFF Heart of Texas show after completing a secret four-week preparation. She managed to keep her comeback so well hidden that she did not even inform her husband until just days before the event. Grace explained that her primary motivation was not winning, but rather reconnecting with herself and finding a reminder of who she is. This marks her return to the bodybuilding world following her previous competitions in 2023.

stories.title: TNA schedules San Antonio meet-and-greets
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling has announced a comprehensive lineup of fan meet-and-greets and photo opportunities in San Antonio, scheduled for September 24 and 25 at the Boeing Center at Tech Port. The events feature high-profile talent including The Hardys, Nic Nemeth, Mustafa Ali, and a dedicated Knockouts photo op session. These appearances build on previously announced Hardy Party events taking place earlier in the week in Houston and San Antonio.

stories.title: Steve Maclin storyline arrest in Canada ahead of Adam Copeland match
stories.tldr: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling star Steve Maclin was arrested by Canadian authorities following a violent rampage on television. After ambushing Rhino, attacking the referee, delivering a conchairto, and assaulting a medical doctor, law enforcement escorted Maclin to a jail cell. MLP President Scott D'Amore supported the arrest and warned that Maclin's upcoming pay-per-view match against Adam Copeland is now in jeopardy.

stories.title: ECW Anarchy Rulz 1999 flashback: Taz loses ECW title
stories.tldr: On September 19, 1999, Extreme Championship Wrestling presented its Anarchy Rulz pay-per-view, drawing a record-setting crowd and gate of nearly 6,000 fans and 208,000 dollars. The landmark event saw a departing Taz drop the ECW Championship to newcomer Mike Awesome in a risky maneuver designed to protect the prestige of the belt. Industry analysis highlighted how internet spoilers surprisingly turned the live crowd against Taz, while praising the strategic choice of Awesome over unproven or prematurely pushed talent. Awesome entered the company with a history primarily based in Japan, bringing immense physical size and high-flying ability alongside certain structural weaknesses that required careful booking.

stories.title: Bully Ray says Motor City Machine Guns feud led to Team 3D split
stories.tldr: While discussing the Motor City Machine Guns on Busted Open Radio, wrestling veteran Bully Ray credited Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin for significantly impacting his career. He revealed that their 2010 TNA feud and a historic moment where Sabin became the first person to ever kick out of the 3D finisher directly caused Team 3D to split up. This split ultimately paved the way for Bully Ray to debut his iconic singles character by turning on D-Von Dudley.

stories.title: Steph De Lander clarifies her status with TNA Wrestling
stories.tldr: Steph De Lander has confirmed that she currently has no relationship or communication with TNA Wrestling following her departure from the company back in March. During a recent interview, she revealed that her exit culminated in her demanding her release papers via email, which she received without further discussion. Although she is not currently on speaking terms with higher-ups and does not foresee a return in the near future, she acknowledged that the unpredictable nature of the wrestling industry means she would never permanently rule out a future comeback.

stories.title: Top pro wrestling matches on September 19 in history
stories.tldr: This retrospective looks at the top ten pro wrestling matches in history that took place on September 19, based on Cagematch ratings and Wrestling Observer Newsletter influence. The list highlights incredible bouts from promotions like Pro Wrestling NOAH, New Japan Pro Wrestling, CMLL, and more. Special attention is given to the 2025 clash between Mistico and MJF, which earned a five and a half star rating. Dave Meltzer provided extensive analysis on how that match solidified Mistico's legendary status in Mexico.

stories.title: WCW Fall Brawl 1993 flashback
stories.tldr: WCW Fall Brawl 1993 took place on September 19 and is widely remembered as one of the worst major pay per view events of the entire decade. Dave Meltzer's review in the Wrestling Observer Newsletter noted that not a single match reached three stars despite featuring legendary talent like Ric Flair, Sting, and Cactus Jack. Critics panned the sluggish matches, uninspired booking, and the decision to showcase uncharismatic big men while leaving stars like Steve Austin and Chris Benoit off the card.

stories.title: Title changes that occurred on September 19 in wrestling history
stories.tldr: September 19 is a historically significant date in professional wrestling, having played host to approximately 285 major and notable title changes over the years. Across various promotions including WCW, ECW, WWE, TNA, ROH, NJPW, and CMLL, this date has seen legendary champions capture gold. Notable moments range from Rick Rude winning the WCW International Title in 1993 to Daniel Bryan claiming the WWE United States Championship in a busy 2010 pay-per-view era.

stories.title: Bret Hart comments on Bill Goldberg injuring himself at WCW Starrcade 1999
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Bret Hart recently reflected on the chaotic aftermath of his infamous match against Bill Goldberg at WCW Starrcade 1999. Hart revealed that Goldberg never apologized for the concussion Hart suffered, even as Hart was forced to wrestle Chris Benoit the very next day. During a subsequent TV segment where Goldberg chased Hart to a getaway car, Goldberg foolishly tried to smash the vehicle's windshield and severely sliced open his own arm. The gruesome injury caused Goldberg to turn white, nearly faint, and get rushed away in an ambulance.

stories.title: Editorial on the ongoing competition between AEW and WWE
stories.tldr: In this latest installment of The Phantom Rant, columnist Joseph Davis reflects on wrestling history from the post-9/11 era to the current promotional war between AEW and WWE. He praises the recent handling of Triple A and a stellar episode of Raw featuring Roman Reigns and Penta. Davis then analyzes the upcoming September 27th Chicago showdown where WWE is running a competing show against a sold-out AEW pay-per-view, viewing it as a continuation of WWE's decades-long strategy to counter rival promotions.

stories.title: Ryback calls for universal drug testing in televised wrestling
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Ryback recently took to social media to advocate for universal drug testing across all major televised professional wrestling promotions. He praised WWE for implementing its Wellness Policy, calling it a vital step for talent health and safety. Ryback noted that while medically necessary hormone treatments should be physician monitored, publicly normalizing steroid abuse is harmful to performers and young fans. Ultimately, he emphasized that his stance comes from a place of protecting wrestlers rather than attacking anyone.

stories.title: Elayna Black reflects on stepping away from wrestling and mental health before joining TNA
stories.tldr: Elayna Black recently opened up about her decision to take a mental health sabbatical following her WWE release and how the break ultimately renewed her passion for the industry. She also contrasted the creative environment in TNA with her previous run, praising its tight-knit locker room culture. Additionally, Black is currently eyeing championship gold as she prepares for a crucial upcoming match in the Knockouts division.

stories.title: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling news and card updates
stories.tldr: Following Gisele Shaw dropping the Maple Leaf Pro Women's Championship to Priscilla Kelly ahead of her exclusive NWA move, several new matches and details have emerged for the upcoming Northern Rising pay-per-view. The updated October 3 card in Toronto now features a Monster's Mayhem three-way match, alongside high-profile bouts including Josh Alexander against Stu Grayson and Adam Copeland facing Steve Maclin. Additionally, reports reveal that Shaw's title loss was accelerated because her new NWA contract prohibits appearances on other television shows.

stories.title: Moose discusses TNA future and offers from other companies
stories.tldr: Following his career-saving victory over Frankie Kazarian, Moose has opened up about his long-term future with TNA. The veteran star revealed that he receives contract offers from every major wrestling promotion whenever his deal expires. While he has dream matches he would love to have in places like WWE or AEW, he ultimately weighs these opportunities against family needs and unfinished goals in TNA. At 42 years old, the multi-time champion remains with the promotion while continuing to evaluate his career path.

stories.title: AJ Francis discusses football career versus pro wrestling
stories.tldr: AJ Francis recently targeted Avery Styles in TNA to get revenge on AJ Styles for an unprovoked attack during their WWE days. Amidst this ongoing family feud, Francis revealed in a recent interview that he believes his wrestling career is currently peaking. He also reflected on his transition from the NFL, noting that while professional wrestling is punishing, football was ultimately much harder on his body.

stories.title: Dark Silueta credits coaches for growth of CMLL Amazonas division
stories.tldr: Expanding on her previous comments about faction requirements, Dark Silueta highlighted the vital role of CMLL coaches in elevating the entire Amazonas division over her 20-year career. She credited mentors like Ultimo Guerrero, El Satanico, and Averno for the high in-ring quality that has driven the division's success. This strong training foundation has allowed the women of CMLL to headline major events and secure international partnerships with AEW and STARDOM.

stories.title: Persephone retains CMLL Women's title with Eddie Guerrero tribute
stories.tldr: At the same anniversary event, Persephone successfully defended the CMLL World Women's Championship in a four-way match against Mina Shirakawa, Starlight Kid, and Tessa Blanchard. She secured the victory by executing a classic Eddie Guerrero trick, throwing her belt to Blanchard and playing dead to draw a disqualification. This marks her latest successful defense over Blanchard following previous bouts earlier this year in Las Vegas and Mexico City.

stories.title: Jake Hager recovering from emergency surgery following eye injury
stories.tldr: Former WWE and AEW star Jake Hager suffered a brutal left eye injury during his recent Power Slap loss to Johnny Magna in Lubbock, Texas, which resulted in a bloody referee stoppage. Following the terrifying incident, Hager was hospitalized and has now undergone emergency surgery. His partner has provided a public update confirming he is recovering and thanking the combat sports community for their overwhelming support.

stories.title: M By Elegance discusses her TNA Championship run
stories.tldr: Following her recent successful title defense against Kiera Hogan, M By Elegance credits her entire TNA championship run to the support of The Elegance Brand. In a recent interview, she outlined ambitious goals to elevate the Knockouts Television Championship to the prestige of the X-Division title. She also named several potential challengers from both TNA and WWE NXT whom she would welcome into the ring.

stories.title: Backstage producers revealed for AAA TripleMania 34 Night Two
stories.tldr: Following the recent TripleMania 34 Night Two event, the backstage producer assignments for the major matches have been revealed. Industry veterans and active talent stepped into behind-the-scenes roles to help lay out the card. These assignments cover high-profile bouts including the championship changes and chaotic street fights.

stories.title: Darby Allin Set to Defend TNT Championship on AEW Collision
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan has announced that Darby Allin will defend his TNT Championship against Myron Reed on the September 19 episode of AEW Collision. Reed stepped up to sign Allin's open contract following a recent momentum-building trios victory with The Rascalz. This marks Allin's second defense of his third TNT title reign, which he began by defeating Kevin Knight at AEW All In. The live broadcast from Charleston, West Virginia, airing on TNT and HBO Max, also features Andrade El Idolo defending the AEW National Championship against Daniel Garcia, alongside a match between Thekla and Zayda Steel.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Reflects on AEW All In 2026 Entrance
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay recently reflected on his emotional and elaborate entrance at AEW All In ahead of his match against Kenny Omega. The memorable walk featured nods to his past rivals, a video package narrated by his mother, and music by The Who. Ospreay ultimately emerged victorious from the contest to capture his first-ever AEW World Championship.

stories.title: WWE-TNA Partnership Impact on AEW
stories.tldr: The working relationship between WWE and TNA has not achieved the anticipated negative impact on AEW that some initially hoped for. While the partnership provided TNA with a short-term boost during their television deal negotiations, WWE television involvement has recently decreased significantly with no talent appearances ahead of Bound For Glory. Furthermore, plans to secure a Wednesday night TV slot to directly compete with AEW Dynamite failed to materialize, and the crossover ultimately highlighted a talent disparity that may cause long-term drawbacks for TNA.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Suggests Removing Young Bucks From AEW Trios Titles
stories.tldr: AEW World Trios Champion Swerve Strickland recently suggested a major cosmetic change to the championship title belts during a brief interview. He believes that Matt and Nick Jackson, the Young Bucks, should have their superkick side plates removed since they are no longer champions and function as a tag team rather than a trio. Strickland and his stablemates currently hold the titles, while the Young Bucks chase different championship gold ahead of the upcoming All Out event.

stories.title: AEW Stars Expected to Participate at NJPW Wrestle Kingdom 21
stories.tldr: NJPW has announced Wrestle Kingdom 21 for January 2027 at the Tokyo Dome, generating strong anticipation for AEW talent participation. Several prominent names under AEW contract, including former NJPW stars and champions, are heavily rumored to make an impact at the iconic event. Potential storylines involve faction tensions in the United Empire, championship defenses, and massive grudge matches. This crossover continues the fruitful ongoing partnership between AEW, NJPW, and CMLL.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer Reports AEW Fines Stars for Swearing on TV
stories.tldr: AEW wrestlers are facing legitimate financial penalties for swearing on television despite the company's historical leniency with strong language. During a recent review of Dynamite, journalists revealed that talent receive a five hundred dollar fine for cursing, which may be low enough to encourage repeat offenses. This internal enforcement follows a past request from network partners to tone down profanity following high profile incidents involving talent like MJF.

stories.title: Debating Whether AEW Should Add Another Weekly TV Show
stories.tldr: With an expanding roster of around 200 contracted stars, questions are being raised about whether AEW needs to add another weekly television show. Currently relying on Dynamite and Collision for four hours of weekly programming, the company struggles to feature all of its talent adequately. Potential solutions include reviving YouTube shows like AEW Dark, securing a new television or streaming deal, or utilizing the MyAEW platform. Adding more content could help showcase overlooked talent and grow the audience, though scheduling and broadcast partnerships require careful navigation.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Criticizes MJF's Finishing Move
stories.tldr: During a recent interview, Swerve Strickland did not hold back when asked to name the worst finishing move in AEW, directly calling out MJF for using a piledriver previously associated with Adam Cole. Strickland claimed that MJF simply stole the move along with everything else from Cole. In the same interview, Strickland also shared his thoughts on the AEW Trios Championship, suggesting that the side plates featuring the Young Bucks should be replaced to properly reflect the current titleholders.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov Reportedly Signs With AEW
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Ilja Dragunov has officially signed with All Elite Wrestling and is expected to debut in the near future. Reports indicate that the promotion has already begun preparing internal materials and debut graphics behind the scenes. His exact arrival date is currently being finalized while his post-WWE visa situation is sorted out.

stories.title: AEW All Out and WWE Worlds Collide Head-to-Head Battle in Chicago
stories.tldr: As the September 26 head-to-head battle between AEW All Out and WWE Worlds Collide in Chicago approaches, updated match cards and ticket distribution figures reveal contrasting booking strategies. AEW is leaning heavily into championship bouts, while WWE's crossover event features fewer titles but boasts major star power like CM Punk. Meanwhile, AEW commentator Jim Ross has publicly criticized WWE's blatant counterprogramming attempt, arguing that the industry would benefit more from mutual growth rather than targeted competition.

stories.title: Jim Ross Comments on AEW Star Rebel's Battle With ALS
stories.tldr: Following AEW's emotional tribute episode for Tanea Rebel Brooks and the late Andy Williams, Jim Ross is urging fans to donate to ALS research. Brooks publicly shared her terminal ALS diagnosis in May, prompting a massive wave of support from across the wrestling industry. During a special episode of Dynamite, AEW revealed a 140,000 dollar donation to leading advocacy groups while featuring appearances from several visiting wrestling stars.

stories.title: Tony Schiavone Discusses Steven Borden's Entrance Concept
stories.tldr: Tony Schiavone recently revealed that his viral It is Steven introductory call on AEW Dynamite was a spur of the moment decision made to honor Steven Borden and his legendary father. Schiavone admitted he briefly debated whether to make the nod to his famous Sting introductions but ultimately trusted his instincts to help the newcomer carve out his path. The veteran announcer praised Bordens impressive athletic background and vocal similarities to his dad, predicting a very bright future for him in the industry.

stories.title: Money in the Bank Qualifiers Set and Results on WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: During the September 18 episode of WWE SmackDown in Corpus Christi, Texas, United States Champions Trick Williams and Jacy Jayne both punched their tickets to the 2026 Money in the Bank ladder matches by winning chaotic triple threat qualifying bouts. Williams defeated Randy Orton and Rey Fenix with the help of a late Trick Shot, while Jayne opportunistically stole a pin over Alexa Bliss after Jade Cargill interfered. The victories bring the confirmed participants to three per side ahead of the October 10 premium live event in New Orleans, with more high-stakes qualifiers scheduled for the upcoming week.

stories.title: Malakai Black Opens Up About WWE Second Run and Release
stories.tldr: Malakai Black recently opened up about his second WWE run and subsequent release following WrestleMania 42, calling the stint a frustrating dud of a year due to unfulfilled creative promises. He revealed that a major program against Randy Orton was originally planned for WrestleMania before plans were altered. Following his release alongside his wife Xelina, Black received crucial mental support from longtime friend Big Damo and quickly transitioned to the independent scene, ultimately capturing the PROGRESS World Championship.

stories.title: Sami Zayn Defeats Kevin Owens to Retain WWE Title on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Sami Zayn successfully defended his Undisputed WWE Championship against his best friend-turned-rival Kevin Owens in the main event of SmackDown. The match descended into absolute chaos with heavy outside interference from Johnny Gargano, Candice LeRae, and CM Punk, who ultimately struck Owens with the title belt. A bizarre sequence of referee confusion preceded the definitive finish where Zayn hit another Helluva Kick to secure the win. To close out the show, CM Punk laid out both Zayn and Owens with the GTS.

stories.title: Mason Rook Garnering High Praise and Opportunities in WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Rising WWE NXT star Mason Rook is preparing for a major championship opportunity while discussing his physique and unique path to the company. Rook, formerly known as Will Kroos on the UK independent scene, has also drawn high praise from John Cena, who originally discovered the wrestler on international television broadcasts. Cena has lauded Rook for his exceptional storytelling and in-ring intelligence rather than just his moves. Now set to challenge Grayson Waller for the NXT Championship, Rook aims to balance physical evolution while staying true to the identity that brought him success.

stories.title: Chelsea Green Reflects on SmackDown Promo, Injury, and Match vs. Nia Jax
stories.tldr: WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green recently reflected on the turbulent early stages of her title reign, which was elevated by a timely broken orbital bone injury and a collaborative promo with Nick Aldis. Despite wrestling through the injury to successfully defend her title against Nia Jax in Mexico City, Green faced a sharp contrast between the live crowd's enthusiastic reaction and harsh online criticism. To stay grounded, she relies on the honest feedback of trusted peers like Jordynne Grace and the perspective of her husband Matt Cardona.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Addresses Character Direction and Fan Perception
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes addressed ongoing speculation about his morality and a potential heel turn during a sit-down interview with Michael Cole on SmackDown following his costly refusal to punt Randy Orton at Sunday Night's Main Event. The interview came in response to mounting criticism from fans and wrestling veterans like Bully Ray, who warned that Rhodes is dangerously close to losing the crowd due to his stale character and questionable decisions. While Rhodes defended his historic babyface run and refused to force an artificial character change for online approval, he acknowledged that he must learn from his mistakes and adjust his approach moving forward.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes' Tour Bus Involved in Traffic Accident
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes private tour bus, recognizable by its Street Fighter promotional wrap, was reportedly involved in a traffic accident in Texas hours before WWE SmackDown. A viral photo from Houston showed the bus pulled over next to a heavily damaged vehicle with first responders at the scene, though official details and injury reports remain unconfirmed by WWE or Rhodes. Despite the incident, Rhodes is still advertised to appear on tonight's episode in Corpus Christi for an exclusive sit-down interview with Michael Cole following his loss to Randy Orton. This marks the second major travel scare for Rhodes and his bus, following a vehicle fire in Philadelphia just days before WrestleMania 40 in April 2024.

stories.title: Club WWE Adds Classic Raw Episodes to Membership Service
stories.tldr: The Club WWE fan membership service has added a new perk offering exclusive access to four classic, full-length episodes of Monday Night Raw from 2009 to 2016. These specific broadcasts are currently unavailable on Netflix, which still has a significant gap in its Raw Vault covering March 2001 through the start of 2022. Priced at $99 annually, Club WWE also features other exclusive content like Stephanie Vaquer winning the Women's World Championship at a live event in Chile, along with a fan vote for the WWE 2K27 video game cover.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano Details Scrapped Trish Stratus Feud
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Zoey Serrano recently discussed a scrapped singles feud with Hall of Famer Trish Stratus that followed their alliance during Stratus's 2023 rivalry with Becky Lynch. Although Serrano attacked Stratus at WWE Payback 2023 to seemingly set up a program between them, the anticipated feud never materialized because Stratus stepped away from television. Serrano admitted that while the missed opportunity could have changed the trajectory of her career, she rolls with the punches and understands that not everything works out in professional wrestling.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano Pitched Modern Right to Censor Character in WWE
stories.tldr: Recently released WWE talent Zoey Serrano revealed that she repeatedly pitched a modern-day version of the Attitude Era Right to Censor gimmick to company creatives, but her ideas were ultimately dismissed. Serrano originally tested the waters online using the hashtag #ZSCENSORED, where she playfully censored and criticized the social media presentation of roster members like Liv Morgan and Rhea Ripley. According to Serrano, Morgan actually encouraged her to develop the persona and gave her full permission to use her photos. Although the concept never made it to television, Serrano believes it was a major missed opportunity given the current landscape of professional wrestling.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Ticket Sales and Broadcast Information for 9/18/2026
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown emanates tonight from the Hilliard Center Arena in Corpus Christi, Texas, with 5,193 tickets distributed so far according to recent tracking data. The show features a loaded lineup including Sami Zayn addressing the Undisputed WWE Title, Cody Rhodes returning for an exclusive interview, and a women money in the bank qualifying match. Fans can catch the broadcast live starting at 8pm Eastern time with global viewing options available across multiple time zones.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown 9/18/2026 Review and Analysis
stories.tldr: The September 18, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown featured an Undisputed WWE Championship match between Sami Zayn and Kevin Owens alongside Money in the Bank qualifiers. Reviewers offered mixed opinions on the night, particularly debating the booking of the men's qualifier featuring Rey Fenix, Randy Orton, and Trick Williams. While some critics were frustrated by Fenix missing out on a ladder match spot and champions competing for other opportunities, others praised the entertaining in-ring chemistry of the triple threat match. Overall, the show delivered significant fallout and discussion regarding the blue brand's roster.

stories.title: Pat McAfee Responds to Viral ESPN Show Speculation
stories.tldr: Pat McAfee sparked viral speculation during a live episode of his ESPN show when he was seen handling a smoking item with visible smoke around his desk. Although the footage did not show him actively taking a hit, fans quickly took to social media to discuss the incident. McAfee responded lightheartedly on X by claiming he was just burning sage before quickly pivoting to discuss football and praise the Buffalo Bills.

stories.title: Original WrestleMania 42 Plans for Randy Orton Revealed
stories.tldr: Recently released WWE star Malakai Black revealed that he was originally scheduled to face Randy Orton at WrestleMania 42 instead of Cody Rhodes. Black even went so far as to commission a special smoking jacket with a remote-controlled smoke effect designed by Jason Baker and operated by Vega for the grand event. Although the creative plans eventually shifted and Orton went on to challenge for the Undisputed WWE Championship against Rhodes, Black chose to debut the unique jacket on the independent scene. The revelation highlights how drastically WWE creative plans can change over a few months, turning what was supposed to be a major WrestleMania showcase into a brief television feud.

stories.title: Speculation on Future WWE United States Champions After Trick Williams
stories.tldr: Following Trick Williams winning back the WWE United States Championship at Sunday Night's Main Event for his second reign, speculation has grown regarding who could capture the midcard title next. Several prominent competitors are highlighted as potential first-time champions, including established main eventers seeking Grand Slam status and younger stars chasing history. Names like Cody Rhodes, Je'Von Evans, Kit Wilson, Ricky Saints, and Drew McIntyre all present compelling storylines for the championship moving forward.

stories.title: Club WWE Launches Exclusive CM Punk Merchandise
stories.tldr: WWE has launched a new ninety-nine dollar a year membership program called Club WWE, which recently introduced an exclusive CM Punk pocket t-shirt for subscribers. Beyond this merchandise drop, the platform offers perks like early ticket access, gold membership experiences, bonus behind-the-scenes content, and voting power for future events such as the WWE 2K27 cover star. While the steep annual price tag has raised some eyebrows given recent ticket price controversies, the program aims to appeal to hardcore fans through a mix of physical and digital rewards.

stories.title: Speculation on Next WWE NXT Champion After Grayson Waller
stories.tldr: Grayson Waller recently captured the WWE NXT Championship in a four-way match at the Heatwave premium live event, establishing an interesting dynamic as a former main roster star holding the developmental brand's top prize. With WWE looking toward its next generation of top prospects, several rising competitors have emerged as potential threats to dethrone him. Mason Rook, Zilla Fatu, and Cruz Montana are among the leading contenders positioned to challenge Waller and eventually capture the gold.

stories.title: WWE Searching for the 'Next Big Thing' After Brock Lesnar
stories.tldr: Following Brock Lesnar's retirement, WWE is actively searching for its next definitive top star to fill a major roster vacancy. Sunday Night's Main Event on September 6 featured a high-stakes clash between Oba Femi and Bron Breakker that ended in a disqualification due to Bronson Reed's return. Several prominent names, including Logan Paul and LA Knight, are also being evaluated by management to potentially step into this elite tier. Meanwhile, impending retirements from veterans like Roman Reigns could soon reshape the company's main event scene even further.

stories.title: Predicting the Next WWE Women's Tag Team Champions
stories.tldr: Fallon Henley and Lainey Reid of Fatal Influence currently hold the WWE Women’s Tag Team Championship after winning the gold in July. With recent successful defenses and ongoing division speculation, several teams have emerged as potential contenders to dethrone the champions. Analysts are eyeing groups ranging from returning veterans and established stables to promising new alliances as the next likely titleholders.

stories.title: Natalya Discusses Her Grittier 'Nattie' Character Shift
stories.tldr: WWE veteran Natalya recently discussed the ongoing evolution of her grittier Nattie character, which officially debuted at the 2026 Royal Rumble following stints in Bloodsport and NXT. She explained that while WrestleMania season temporarily halted her momentum due to pre-existing plans, she is fully dedicated to expanding the persona on the main roster. Drawing inspiration from her roots in her grandfather Stu Hart's legendary dungeon, Nattie is a throwback to her earliest wrestling days rather than a traditional MMA gimmick. Ultimately, she believes in maintaining an unrelenting work ethic, citing advice from Bubba Dudley and the example set by Rey Mysterio to continually pay her dues despite having nearly 2,000 matches and seven Guinness World Records to her name.

stories.title: Fake Aalyah Mysterio Social Media Account Flagged
stories.tldr: A fake social media account pretending to be newly signed WWE recruit Aalyah Mysterio has been active since August 2023 and has amassed over 5,000 followers. After posting a photo from the WWE Performance Center to solicit fan support, the profile was hit with an X Community Note exposing the impersonation. Despite being flagged and linked to a location in Africa, the account continues to slide into fans direct messages to start suspicious conversations. This incident follows alarming recent scams involving impersonators of Liv Morgan and Rhea Ripley who defrauded fans out of tens of thousands of dollars.

stories.title: Jim Johnston Recalls How He Was Hired by WWE
stories.tldr: Legendary WWE composer Jim Johnston recently shared the amusing story of how he landed his iconic gig with the company in 1985 through a chance meeting at a local Japanese restaurant. After a regular acquaintance at the sushi bar asked if he could write music for a video project, Johnston admitted he half-assed lied about his qualifications to secure the opportunity. The mystery man turned out to be Vince McMahon's art director, and the initial assignment involved composing music for a cable TV conference rather than actual wrestling broadcasts. This fateful encounter kicked off a legendary three-decade career that resulted in the most iconic entrance themes in pro wrestling history.

stories.title: Released WWE Stars Set to Return Across Various Promotions
stories.tldr: Across this year, several main roster and NXT stars have been released or chosen to leave WWE, including notable departures like Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods following proposed pay cuts. Despite these exits and potential friction, the door to a WWE return remains open for many athletes through independent runs and cross-promotional partnerships. Talents such as the Wyatt Sicks, Kairi Sane, Tonga Loa, Zoey Stark, Andre Chase, and Ridge Holland could all realistically find their way back to WWE programming in the future. Time spent outside the company often increases a performer's value, proving that the wrestling industry rarely closes its doors permanently.

stories.title: Vince Russo Criticizes Seth Rollins Over Mexico City Airport Video
stories.tldr: Former WWE head writer Vince Russo heavily criticized Seth Rollins on The Coach and Bro Show after viral airport footage from Mexico showed Rollins rushing ahead while Becky Lynch was swarmed by an aggressive crowd. Russo argued that Rollins should have grabbed his wife by the arm and ensured they escaped together rather than leaving her behind, regardless of Lynch being a tough competitor who can handle herself. While the short video clip does not capture the full context of the chaotic situation, it has sparked widespread online debate about how Rollins handled the airport departure.

stories.title: Triple H Praises Endeavor CEO Ari Emanuel
stories.tldr: WWE Chief Content Officer Paul Triple H Levesque recently took to social media to heavily praise TKO Group Holdings Executive Chairman Ari Emanuel. In a video shared from WWE headquarters following a busy weekend of global touring, Triple H promoted Emanuel's upcoming book titled Roll the Calls. He described the release as an authentic and direct look at succeeding in the worlds of business and entertainment.

stories.title: Carmella Addresses Possible Return to WWE
stories.tldr: Former WWE Women’s Champion Carmella has addressed a potential return to the company, indicating that while she is not entirely ruling out a comeback, a full-time return is unlikely in the near future. Having not wrestled since 2023 due to pregnancy and subsequent health challenges involving drop foot, Carmella welcomed her second child with husband Corey Graves in October 2025 around the time her WWE contract expired. During a recent podcast appearance, she explained that her young family remains her top priority and she would regret being away on a grueling travel schedule.

stories.title: Zoey Serrano Recalls Health Scare Ahead of WWE Raw Main Event
stories.tldr: Zoey Serrano recently reflected on a frightening health scare that occurred just before her WWE Raw main event against Becky Lynch in 2023. While eating Memphis barbecue, she developed a severe swelling under her chin that was later diagnosed as a stone lodged in her salivary gland. Despite dealing with intense health anxiety and heavy makeup to hide the swelling, she successfully competed in her first ever weapons match. Although the bout was a career highlight, Serrano ultimately views the lack of a follow-up singles feud after Trish Stratus turned on her as a missed opportunity.

stories.title: Discussion on TKO's Business Approach to Professional Wrestling
stories.tldr: This article explores whether modern professional wrestling promoters, particularly under TKO's corporate approach, are becoming too complacent and risk-averse in their booking decisions. Drawing on recent commentary regarding how stars are utilized and historical examples like the rise of Stone Steve Austin, the piece argues that promoters must remain flexible and willing to capitalize on organic momentum rather than sticking rigidly to predetermined plans. Without healthy industry competition, there is a constant danger that the product will stagnate and fail to evolve with its audience.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Google Search Trends Analysis
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown is experiencing a notable decline in digital engagement, with Google Search interest dropping ten percent over the past three months and twenty percent compared to the same period last year. Despite major moments like Sami Zayn defeating CM Punk for the WWE Title, recent episodes have failed to spark significant online spikes. The awkward timing of the upcoming Money in the Bank premium live event creates a challenging transitional period for weekly television builds. Creative teams may need fresh storylines, such as a potential CM Punk heel turn or shifting focus to Roman Reigns versus LA Knight, to reverse this downward trend in audience curiosity.

stories.title: WON Flashback Review of WWE Unforgiven 2005
stories.tldr: September 18 2005 marked the date of WWE Unforgiven, featuring a widely panned encounter between The Big Show and Gene Snitsky. Dave Meltzer famously rated the six-minute bout a meager half-star, calling it a dull affair defined mostly by arm work and a sluggish pace. The most memorable segment outside of the wrestling itself involved introducing members of ZZ Top to the live crowd. Big Show ultimately secured the victory with a chokeslam before awkwardly delivering a follow-up ring bell shot to officially blow off the feud.

stories.title: LA Knight Appearance and MITB Qualifiers Set for WWE Raw
stories.tldr: Following the confirmation of his Money in the Bank title match against Roman Reigns, LA Knight will address the fans on the upcoming episode of Monday Night Raw. Additionally, WWE has announced two triple threat qualifying matches for the ladder matches. The men's division will see Solo Sikoa, Dominik Mysterio, and Dragon Lee face off, while Roxanne Perez, IYO SKY, and AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina will battle on the women's side.

stories.title: Liv Morgan and Rhea Ripley Online Impersonation Scams Targeted
stories.tldr: Following earlier reports of celebrity impersonation schemes, new victims have come forward detailing massive financial losses tied to fake WWE accounts. A fan named Scott Hyman claims he lost over $104,000 to Liv Morgan impersonators who used sophisticated tactics, including a personalized fake video. Wrestling personalities Vince Russo and Jonathan Coachman have since addressed the issue, warning fans that predatory scammers are actively targeting vulnerable individuals.

stories.title: WWE Prepares More Money in the Bank Qualifiers
stories.tldr: WWE has finalized the specific matchups for its upcoming Money in the Bank qualifying matches across next week's television broadcasts. Raw will host triple threat bouts including Dragon Lee versus Solo Sikoa versus Dominik Mysterio, and La Catalina versus Roxanne Perez versus Iyo Sky. Meanwhile, SmackDown is highlighted by a major men's triple threat between CM Punk, Finn Balor, and Gunther, alongside a women's qualifier featuring Giulia, Charlotte Flair, and Lash Legend.

stories.title: Speculation Surrounding Future WWE Women's Champions Heading to WrestleMania 43
stories.tldr: Interim champion Chelsea Green recently returned from an orbital injury to successfully defend her title against Nia Jax, while WWE creative plans eye the road to WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia. Alongside Green, sidelined lineal champion Rhea Ripley works toward an eventual return, and veterans like Charlotte Flair and IYO SKY remain major title threats. Meanwhile, Sol Ruca is preparing for the upcoming Money in the Bank ladder match on October 10 as she targets her first world championship.

stories.title: Lil Yachty Discusses CM Punk Fandom and Sobriety Journey
stories.tldr: Lil Yachty recently signed an official WWE contract after managing Trick Williams and making his in-ring debut. Expanding on his wrestling journey, the rapper revealed that training for the squared circle forced him to undergo a massive physical transformation. He credited both his rigorous conditioning and a lifelong fandom of straight-edge star CM Punk for helping him get sober.

stories.title: Speculation on WWE Women's World Championship Picture at WrestleMania 43
stories.tldr: Following her recent title victory, speculation is heating up regarding the WWE Women's World Championship picture for WrestleMania 43. WWE management reportedly has creative plans locked in for the event, barring any injuries. Analysts are closely watching four major contenders, including Stephanie Vaquer, Becky Lynch, Liv Morgan, and Roxanne Perez, to see who will headline the upcoming Show of Shows.

stories.title: WWE NXT Star Kendal Grey Injury Severity Update
stories.tldr: Kendal Grey remains sidelined from NXT due to ongoing ear and vestibular issues, including persistent vertigo, dizziness, and anxiety. Fellow wrestler Wren Sinclair recently revealed that Grey actually worsened her condition by continuing to wrestle and completing a road loop against medical advice. Sinclair noted that the injury is much more severe than anyone realizes because Grey refuses to slow down on her own.

stories.title: Jake Hager Suffers Severe Eye Injury and Post-Match Incident at Power Slap 23
stories.tldr: Former WWE and AEW star Jake Hager suffered a severe left eye injury during his Power Slap 23 loss to Johnny Magna in Lubbock, Texas. The brutal strike left Hager bleeding heavily from his eye and ear, prompting the referee to stop the fight and leading Dana White to call it one of the worst injuries in UFC or Power Slap history. Hager subsequently underwent emergency eye surgery, while also nearly getting into a backstage altercation with a college basketball team before leaving the venue.

stories.title: Kurt Angle Selects Modern-Day Main Event Mafia Lineup
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Kurt Angle recently revealed his dream modern-day lineup for a reboot of TNA's iconic Main Event Mafia faction. Pulling talent from across different major promotions, his hypothetical four-man group consists of Roman Reigns, Gunther, Kenny Omega, and CM Punk. While acknowledging the incredible star power of this cross-company stable, Angle admitted he still prefers the legendary original 2008 lineup.

stories.title: Soma Takao Wins DDT Farewell Match Ahead of Free Agency
stories.tldr: Soma Takao successfully concluded a major chapter of his career by winning a four-way match at DDT Pro Wrestling's Fighting Beer Garden event in Ueno. Competing in a unique Dropkick-style drunk match where participants had to drink whenever music played, Takao pinned Yuki Ishida to secure the victory. The bout served as an official farewell ahead of his departure from DDT and his role managing the Dropkick bar at the end of September. Takao will transition to becoming a free agent in October, leaving behind a legacy of hard work both in the ring and behind the scenes that was warmly recognized by his peers and fans.

stories.title: Phoenix Championship Wrestling's Anniversary 8 Event
stories.tldr: Phoenix Championship Wrestling is hosting its biggest show of the year, Anniversary 8, tonight at Skyline High School in Mesa, Arizona, with a record-setting crowd of over 2,000 fans expected. The marquee event features a two-out-of-three-falls Tag Team Championship match between the defending Pretty City Xpress and challengers Yung Money. Additional highlights include CJ Valor defending the PCW Championship against Kevin Koa, a special appearance by former WWE star Deuce Jimmy Snuka Jr, and a loaded undercard of independent wrestling talent.

stories.title: Dark Silueta Discusses Requirements for New Las Infernales Members
stories.tldr: Dark Silueta revealed that any potential new members of the CMLL faction Las Infernales must be direct students of its founder, El Satanico. During an interview with Luis Pulido, Silueta explained that lineage matters more than in-ring ability or television fit when joining the group. While wrestlers like Hecate have been suggested and current members often have outside commitments, ultimate approval for expansion rests solely with El Satanico.

stories.title: Maika Returns to STARDOM for Silver Week Tour
stories.tldr: Maika is set to make her triumphant return to STARDOM during the upcoming Silver Week Tour following her excursion in Mexico. She will officially make her comeback in her hometown of Fukuoka on September 22, teaming up with Maki Itoh and Utami Hayashishita. The tour spans four dates across late September, featuring high profile matches including a series of preview bouts for the upcoming Wonder of Stardom Championship match between Hanan and Ruaka. Additionally, celebrity wrestler Fuwa-chan is scheduled to make appearances across all four announced events.

stories.title: AJPW Odo Tournament Second Round Results
stories.tldr: Ryuki Honda pulled off a major upset by defeating reigning Triple Crown Heavyweight Champion Kento Miyahara in the main event of the All Japan Pro Wrestling Odo Tournament second round on September 17. With this massive victory, Honda advanced to the semifinals where he will face Xyon, who earned his own spot by defeating Go Shiozaki. The tournament results have significantly shaken up the bracket as the remaining competitors prepare for the upcoming semifinal matches at Korakuen Hall on September 22.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live Friday Broadcast
stories.tldr: Professional radio host Lance Storm and Filthy Tom Lawlor return for a special Filthy Fun Friday edition of Wrestling Observer Live. The duo discusses a wide variety of professional wrestling topics including recent events on Smackdown, TNA on AMC, and MLW on Tubi. They also touch upon international and historical milestones such as CMLL celebrating 93 years. Listeners can access the entertaining broadcast through the usual online platforms by streaming or right-clicking to save the audio file.

stories.title: AJ Francis Challenges Avery Styles Over Issues With AJ Styles
stories.tldr: AJ Francis recently challenged Avery Styles on TNA iMPACT as a proxy to get to Avery's father, AJ Styles, whom Francis has wanted to fight for years. Francis harbors a grudge stemming from their time in WWE when the elder Styles hit him with an unprovoked Phenomenal Forearm. Although Avery accepted the challenge, Frankie Kazarian intervened before the match could be made official. Francis now plans to target the younger Styles to finally gain the attention of the former WWE Champion.

stories.title: Jasmin St. Claire and NWA's Bryan Idol Exchange Playful Comments
stories.tldr: Former adult film star and wrestling personality Jasmin St. Claire celebrated National Cheeseburger Day on social media with a post about her dinner plans. National Wrestling Alliance star Bryan Idol replied with a suggestive one-word question about buns, prompting an equally flirty and direct response from St. Claire. The playful public exchange quickly escalated as St. Claire made it clear she was specifically targeting Idol's backside in her comments.

stories.title: Vince Russo Addresses JCW Exit Speculation
stories.tldr: Vince Russo has addressed ongoing speculation regarding his status with Juggalo Championship Wrestling, explaining that he currently finds himself in limbo regarding his future with the promotion. While he has previously cited personal reasons like COVID concerns and his wife's recent retirement for missing certain appearances, Russo noted that his initial show-by-show agreement has reached the one-year mark, prompting a natural period of reevaluation. He emphasized to fans that there is no backstage drama or falling out, and directed those seeking full details to his personal subscription platform for an in-depth explanation.

stories.title: Analysis of WWE Buying AAA and Its Effect on CMLL Interest
stories.tldr: Following WWE's acquisition of Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide in April 2025, search interest in the promotion skyrocketed in Mexico and grew significantly in the United States. Google Trends data shows that while AAA experienced a massive surge in brand awareness and baseline interest driven by WWE marketing and stars like Rey Mysterio, rival promotion CMLL also saw a steady, gradual increase in popularity. This phenomenon suggests a rising tide lifts all ships in the Mexican lucha libre market, potentially as casual interest expands or as traditional fans seek out CMLL as an alternative to corporate ownership.

stories.title: Top Pro Wrestling Matches on September 18 in History
stories.tldr: September 18 holds a rich history of incredible professional wrestling matches spanning promotions across the globe. According to Cagematch ratings and Wrestling Observer Newsletter star ratings, bouts from NJPW, Dragongate, WWE, CMLL, and more highlight this date. Topping the list is the legendary 2021 G1 Climax encounter between Shingo Takagi and Tomohiro Ishii, which earned a staggering five and a half star rating from Dave Meltzer.

stories.title: Historical Title Changes on September 18th
stories.tldr: September eighteenth marks a relatively slower day for professional wrestling title changes with approximately two hundred seventy notable historical changes recorded on this date. Major historical highlights include Steve Austin capturing the WCW United States Heavyweight Title in 1994, Ric Flair winning the WWE Intercontinental Title in 2005, and John Cena claiming the WWE Title in 2011. The date also features numerous championship changes across promotions like WCW, WWE, ECW, CMLL, TNA, ROH, and AJPW spanning from 1981 through 2023.

stories.title: Shota Umino Discusses Concussion Recovery and IWGP Global Title Status
stories.tldr: NJPW star Shota Umino has opened up about his severe concussion recovery after being pulled from the G1 Climax earlier this year, detailing struggles with amnesia and daily tasks during his two weeks as a shut-in. Following proper medical protocols and a gradual return to training, Umino successfully made his return during the Destruction tour. He also addressed the IWGP Global Championship picture, noting that memory loss caused by his concussion makes him eager to get closure and challenge the winner of the upcoming title matches.

stories.title: CMLL 93rd Anniversary Event and Results
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett officially completed his high-profile CMLL debut by submitting to Blue Panther at the promotion's anniversary event. In the marquee main event, Místico defeated Averno in a Mask vs. Hair match to keep his undefeated Apuestas record intact. The historic Arena Mexico card also featured a stacked lineup of international stars from AEW, NJPW, and Stardom.

stories.title: MLW Tubi Deal and Tessa Blanchard Situation
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling has secured a rights fee and library revenue-share agreement for its new Tubi streaming deal, which was finalized back in August. Meanwhile, backstage details reveal that the fallout over Tessa Blanchard's aborted MLW debut is more complicated than initially thought. Reports indicate CMLL representatives were actually on the call during Blanchard's TMZ announcement, contradicting the promotion's public stance of being completely caught off guard.

stories.title: Indie Wrestler Ganon Jones Jr. Steps Away Following Andy Williams' Passing
stories.tldr: Independent wrestler Ganon Jones Jr., who competed against Andy Williams in his final match, has announced he is stepping away from the ring. Jones made the decision after his young daughter witnessed the tragic event and texted him asking him to stop wrestling out of fear he might not return home. While he hopes to eventually return, Jones stated that he needs to prioritize being a father right now.

stories.title: Walker Stewart Clarifies Contract Details With NJPW and AEW
stories.tldr: Walker Stewart has revealed the exact lengths and terms of his new agreements across the wrestling industry. His full-time NJPW contract runs through January 2029, while his full-time STARDOM deal extends to June 2027. Additionally, he will make per-appearance AEW appearances one to twice a month, and STARDOM has brought in Jimbo Bonji to share commentary duties with him.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling NOAH N-1 Victory Tournament Updates
stories.tldr: As Pro Wrestling NOAH continues its N-1 Victory tour following recent roster setbacks, the B Block standings are taking shape with Masa Kitamiya pulling ahead as the sole undefeated wrestler. Kitamiya defeated Manabu Soya in Hiroshima to claim six points, while OZAWA handed veteran KENTA his third consecutive loss. Meanwhile, Titus Alexander picked up a victory over Kai Koga and immediately issued a warning to OZAWA ahead of their upcoming clash.

stories.title: Dexter Lumis, Joseph Sawyer, and Erick Redbeard Team at BRCW
stories.tldr: Former WWE stars Erick Redbeard, Sam Shaw, and Joseph Sawyer are officially reuniting to challenge for the BRCW Six-Man Tag Team Championship. The trio will face reigning champions Gangrel and The Righteous at the upcoming Cruisin For A Bruisin 4 event. The high-stakes title match is officially scheduled for November 6, 2026, at the Miami Airport Convention Center in Florida.

stories.title: Paige Collett's Contract Status With NWA Revealed
stories.tldr: Despite frequent appearances alongside Sirena Veil and heavy involvement in recent storylines, Paige Collett is not currently under contract with the National Wrestling Alliance. Speculation regarding her official status grew following other recent roster signings, but sources confirm no paperwork has been finalized. The door remains wide open for a potential full-time deal in the future as fans continue to take notice of her television impact.

stories.title: TNA iMPACT Updates and Bound for Glory Match Additions
stories.tldr: Rich Swann has secured the fourth spot in the upcoming Bound For Glory six-way match for the vacant X-Division Championship after defeating LJ Cleary. Meanwhile, next week's September 24 episode of iMPACT will feature Mustafa Ali defending the TNA International Championship against Jason Hotch and Trey Miguel, alongside a four-way Knockouts TV title eliminator. Additionally, singles action between Eddie Edwards and Elijah has been booked following recent tag team fallout involving The System.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett Set for Semi-Regular Runs in CMLL
stories.tldr: AEW veteran Jeff Jarrett is scheduled to make his CMLL in-ring debut against Blue Panther at the promotion's upcoming anniversary show at Arena Mexico. Although initially billed as a one-night attraction, reports indicate that Jarrett is very interested in turning the appearance into a longer, semi-regular arrangement while remaining under contract with AEW. He hopes to work programs and build toward bigger matches similar to Johnny TV's recent stint, though on a larger scale. While Jarrett has extensive prior history in Mexican lucha libre with AAA, whether this expanded CMLL run will ultimately materialize remains to be seen.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns Missing from AEW Television
stories.tldr: The Motor City Machine Guns have experienced a stop-and-start run in AEW since officially joining the promotion, leading to fan questions about their absence. According to a recent report, their sporadic television appearances are not due to creative issues, but rather because they chose to honor prior tour commitments and projects, including their rock band Grpplng. Although AEW debuted them in Detroit against their initial preference, the veteran duo is expected to have plenty of opportunities in the tag team division once their outside schedule clears.

stories.title: Jim Ross Praises Tony Khan's Recent AEW Booking
stories.tldr: Veteran wrestling broadcaster Jim Ross recently offered high praise for AEW President Tony Khan, highlighting the company's emotional and well-received tribute shows for Rebel and the late Andy Williams, known as The Butcher. Speaking on his podcast, Ross commended Khan for successfully managing these sensitive productions as a solo booker without a committee. Furthermore, Ross noted that he has been genuinely impressed by AEW's recent show formatting and ongoing roster development.

stories.title: AEW Announcer Addresses Speculation Over Bayley
stories.tldr: Bayley's current contract status with WWE remains a subject of intense speculation despite her recent television return and renewed feud with Lyra Valkyria. While conflicting reports circulate regarding whether she has re-signed, fans and analysts continue to wonder if she might eventually follow her best friend Mercedes Mone to AEW. Addressing these rumors on a recent podcast, veteran announcer Jim Ross enthusiastically endorsed the idea of Bayley joining the roster. Ross emphasized that her leadership and in-ring talent would be a tremendous asset to the growing women's division.

stories.title: Jim Ross Gives Health Update After Dermatologist Visit
stories.tldr: Wrestling legend Jim Ross provided a health update on his latest podcast episode following a stressful dermatologist appointment where multiple biopsies were taken from his back. Ross is currently dealing with several ongoing health challenges, including recovering from August brain surgery, broken toes, and a persistent ankle wound stemming from 2021 skin cancer radiation treatments. Despite these hardships, he recently received positive news regarding a non-cancerous kidney mass and remains determined to heal and return to AEW pay-per-view commentary.

stories.title: Jim Ross and Matt Hardy Pay Tribute to Andy 'The Butcher' Williams
stories.tldr: Tributes continue to pour in for the late Andy The Butcher Williams following his tragic passing at age 48. AEW commentator Jim Ross recently shared fond memories of Williams on his podcast, praising his positive attitude and the value he brought to the tag team division. Additionally, TNA star Matt Hardy reflected on his time working with Williams, highlighting his genuine nature and deep appreciation for the wrestling business.

stories.title: Jack Perry's Quest for the AEW World Championship
stories.tldr: Jack Perry is actively pursuing the AEW World Championship by challenging the company's former title holders one by one. Despite suffering early singles losses to Jon Moxley and Swerve Strickland, Perry claims he embraces the defeats as valuable learning experiences. He has now set his sights on other former champions like Samoa Joe, while names like CM Punk are entirely off the table.

stories.title: Big Vinny V Discusses Nick Wayne's Momentum in AEW
stories.tldr: Following his recent loss and violent outburst over his damaged heirloom on Dynamite, analysts are pointing out Nick Wayne's severe lack of momentum on AEW's flagship show. Wayne has not won a match on Dynamite since March 2025 and holds a dismal pay-per-view record. Observers argue that booking Wayne for a standard TV win immediately would help rebuild his credibility ahead of his ongoing program with Chris Jericho.

stories.title: Jim Cornette Shares Doubts on Steven Borden's Wrestling Future
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Jim Cornette recently evaluated Steven Borden following his official AEW in-ring debut alongside Darby Allin. While Cornette praised Steven's impressive physique, athleticism, and pedigree, he expressed serious doubts about his long-term wrestling future. The outspoken manager pointed out that starting a career at age 34 and receiving training from Darby Allin present major hurdles for the rising star.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland Theme Song Approval Before AEW All In
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland recently revealed that the licensing rights for The New Level's entrance music at AEW All In were secured just 24 hours before the event. Speaking on Hot 97, Strickland explained that A$AP Ferg's team gave the final approval for the 2015 hit track right down to the wire. He noted that the dramatic timing created a perfect storm that successfully hyped the Wembley Stadium crowd. Strickland also believes the iconic track provides a refreshing career reset for himself, Austin Creed, and Kofi.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez AEW Dynamite Episode Report
stories.tldr: Subscribers can now access the complete audio breakdown of the September 16 episode of AEW Dynamite. The latest review covers the show's build toward All Out alongside its mixed reception. Listeners can dive into the detailed analysis regarding the matches, performances, and controversial booking decisions from the broadcast.

stories.title: Perry Saturn Recalls Shooting Incident, Backstage Stories, and Struggles
stories.tldr: Former professional wrestler Perry Saturn opened up about his turbulent career, severe drug battles, and harrowing personal history in a recent candid interview. He detailed a 2004 shooting where he was shot in the neck while trying to stop an attack, a tragedy that led to homelessness and a crack addiction before he got clean in 2010. Saturn also shared infamous backstage stories, including a knife-pulling incident with Mike Graham in WCW, the truth behind the Moppy gimmick as punishment for an unscripted attack on Mike Bell, and wild claims regarding Terri Runnels and Jim Ross in WWE.

stories.title: Pennsylvania Man Scammed Out of Money by Rhea Ripley Impersonator
stories.tldr: A 64-year-old Pennsylvania man was scammed out of $42,700 in March by individuals impersonating WWE star Rhea Ripley. Initial local news reports mistakenly claimed the loss was $427,000 before quietly correcting the figure. The unidentified victim has refused to cooperate with the Pennsylvania State Police investigation, and no arrests have been made. This incident highlights a recurring issue of online fraud in professional wrestling, similar to past cases where fans lost massive sums to impersonators.

stories.title: The Rock Unlikely for WrestleMania 43 Build
stories.tldr: WWE creative is currently operating under the assumption that Dwayne The Rock Johnson will not be available for substantial storyline participation or an in-ring match at WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia. Reports indicate that his heavy filming schedule for the upcoming Fast and Furious franchise installment, Fast Forever, makes a wrestling return very unlikely. While sources emphasize that plans involving The Rock can change in an instant, the company is currently mapping out its historic first international WrestleMania without him.

stories.title: Nikki Bella, Brie Bella, and Paige WWE Storyline Plans
stories.tldr: Following their shocking betrayal of Paige at SummerSlam 2026, Nikki and Brie Bella ignited a heated feud. While Brie continues recovering from a broken scapula sustained at the premium live event, Nikki recently faced Paige in a surprisingly brief singles match on SmackDown. Nikki revealed on her podcast that she had originally prepared for a much longer match, but she embraced the short duration as a creative storytelling choice to generate strong heat and leave fans wanting more.

stories.title: WWE Unveils New Performance Center Recruit Class Including Aalyah Mysterio
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced its newest class of Performance Center recruits reporting to Orlando, Florida, headlined by Aalyah Gutierrez, the daughter of Rey Mysterio and sister of Dominik Mysterio. Training under her real name, Gutierrez joins a diverse group of six other new talents from various athletic, amateur wrestling, and independent backgrounds. Notable additions include former TNA referee Katie Reynolds, former WWE ID talent Zoe Sager, and Australian independent standouts Jackson Goonrey and Tyran Tuckey. This fresh wave of signings arrives shortly after a recent round of roster releases and main roster departures in the company.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Promotes Street Fighter Movie With Popcorn Bucket
stories.tldr: WWE star Cody Rhodes has unveiled an unusual AMC Theatres exclusive popcorn bucket shaped like his character Guile's iconic blond hair for the upcoming Street Fighter movie. The wearable, helmet-like collectible was showcased in a promotional video featuring Rhodes alongside his co-stars Noah Centineo and Callina Liang. The star-studded film, which also features fellow WWE Superstar Roman Reigns as Akuma, is scheduled to hit theaters on October 16 with tickets going on sale Monday.

stories.title: Logan Paul WWE Return Timeline Following Injury
stories.tldr: Logan Paul is expected to make his in-ring WWE return around November as he continues to recover from a complete tear of his left triceps tendon sustained on May 23. Although Paul has joked on his vlog about being ready to return sooner, WWE official Michael Hayes and Triple H, along with orthopedic surgeon Dr. Jeffrey Dugas, confirmed that the biology of his elbow requires a full five and a half to six months of healing. Once he is finally cleared, creative plans for his return could include resuming his tag team success with Austin Theory in The Vision, entering into new feuds with stars like Oba Femi or Chad Gable, or pursuing a world championship match against Roman Reigns.

stories.title: Paul Heyman Sit-Down Interview With Graham Bensinger
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Paul Heyman has announced via Instagram Stories that he will participate in an upcoming sit-down interview with journalist Graham Bensinger for In Depth with Graham Bensinger. The long-form interview format will provide Heyman the opportunity to share stories from his legendary four-decade career outside of his usual television setting. While an official air date has not yet been revealed, fans eagerly anticipate hearing his insights on ECW, creative behind-the-scenes work, and monumental modern storylines like The Bloodline.

stories.title: Top Selling WWE Merchandise Stars for Kids
stories.tldr: A recent analysis of WWEShop.com reveals surprising trends in WWE merchandise sales among children, with perennial top sellers like Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes, Rhea Ripley, Alexa Bliss, and Jey Uso joined by notable risers. While established names continue to dominate adult and child demographics alike, newer talents such as Oba Femi and Penta are capturing the imagination of younger fans. In particular, Penta has emerged as the clear leader, dominating the top spots for both kids and adult apparel following stellar performances.

stories.title: Ethan Page Discusses Shift in Personal Goals in WWE
stories.tldr: WWE star Ethan Page recently discussed how his career priorities have evolved over his two-decade journey in professional wrestling. While he still aims to capture major championships like the Intercontinental and world titles, his ultimate ambition is to build a lasting legacy and earn the deep respect of his peers. By highlighting legendary figures who never won a world title but still hold immense industry value, Page emphasized that a strong overall body of work matters most.

stories.title: Total Divas Reboot Casting Rumors
stories.tldr: Rumors are swirling about a potential reboot of the reality television series Total Divas featuring a fresh lineup of WWE talent alongside possible returning veterans. The proposed next generation cast highlights a diverse group of performers including Maxxine Dupri, backstage interviewer Cathy Kelley, and rising stars like Lash Legend, Blake Monroe, and Fallon Henley. Each potential cast member brings a unique perspective, from established locker room friendships and NXT journeys to main roster transitions and built in stable dynamics. This new era of the show aims to capture the modern landscape of women in professional wrestling both inside the ring and behind the scenes.

stories.title: Potential New Tag Team Formations on WWE Main Roster
stories.tldr: A recent report explores potential new tag team formations on the WWE main roster to revitalize struggling solo acts and provide fresh character development. The proposed pairings include Seth Rollins teaming with Oba Femi to target The Vision, Ivy Nile joining forces with Jordynne Grace following internal company pitches, and an odd couple pairing of Ricky Saints and Danhausen on SmackDown. These combinations aim to inject new energy into the tag team division while helping talents connect with the audience and achieve new common goals.

stories.title: Booker T Weighs In on Importance of World Titles
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Booker T recently discussed the true significance of holding a world championship on his podcast. He explained that being chosen for the top spot means the company trusts you to lead them upward and that high pay should naturally follow. Booker emphasized that the actual title carries a lasting legacy far beyond physical hardware, noting that people still respectfully address him as champ on a regular basis.

stories.title: WWE Crown Jewel Status Amid Saudi Arabia Travel Advisory
stories.tldr: Following a recent U.S. State Department travel advisory for Saudi Arabia due to potential Iranian drone and missile threats, WWE is internally discussing the status of Crown Jewel on November 7. While the company is weighing whether it is safe to send talent and personnel to Riyadh, the event is expected to proceed on that date anyway due to broadcast commitments with ESPN. Observers note that even if the location changes or the event is postponed, WWE will not lose its reported multi-million dollar payout, as the missed date would simply be added to the end of their contractual obligations.

stories.title: Roman Reigns vs. Penta Backstage Update and Rematch Status
stories.tldr: While an immediate rematch between Roman Reigns and Penta is not currently planned, WWE views the pairing as a major program that could headline a future Premium Live Event. Penta has solidified his main-event status internally, though Reigns has already moved on to a championship defense against LA Knight at Money in the Bank. Meanwhile, their Mexico City encounter shattered company records by pulling in over 74 million social media views in less than a day.

stories.title: WWE x AAA Worlds Collide Broadcast Plans and Faction Changes
stories.tldr: WWE and AAA are moving forward with their September 26 Worlds Collide event in Rosemont against AEW All Out, with new updates clarifying its broadcast status and match card. While official live streaming plans remain unconfirmed, backstage reports indicate the event is being filmed with commentary. Meanwhile, the five-match card features major cross-promotional bouts that could spark significant faction changes for groups like The Judgment Day.
